sentences.source: Is re-use of harvested maize for planting in successive seasons a common practice?
sentences.translation: Hihi nĩ kũhũthĩrũo rĩngĩ kwa mũtu wa mũtu nĩ ũndũ wa kũhaanda mahinda-inĩ ma ũrugarĩ nĩ ũndũ ũhũthagĩrũo mũno?
sentences.reference: Hihi ũhũthĩri rĩngĩ wa mbembe ciagethetwo no ihandwo imera irũmanĩrĩire?

sentences.source: Train on good agronomic practices, that is, seed selection, correct spacing, fertilizer application and weeding.
sentences.translation: Kũmenyeria mĩtugo mĩega ya ũrĩmi, ũguo nĩ kuuga gũthuura mbeũ, kũiga mbeũ na njĩra njega, kũhũthĩra ndawa cia kũgũra na kũiga mĩmera mĩũru.
sentences.reference: Thomithia ũrĩmi wĩgiĩ gũthuura mbegũ wega,  mũtaganĩrie mwagĩrĩru wa mbegũ, wongereri wa mborera ona kũrĩmĩra

sentences.source: Regions where gender dynamics is pronounced, separate training sessions or seating arrangements of male and female farmers should be adhered to.
sentences.translation: Thĩinĩ wa mabũrũri marĩa kũrĩ na ũgarũrũku mũnene wa maũndũ megiĩ ũrata wa arũme na andũ-a-nja, mĩcemanio ya kũmenyeria arũme na atumia kana mĩikarĩre ya gũikara ya arũme na atumia nĩ yagĩrĩire gwĩkwo.
sentences.reference: Kũrĩ icigo iria ikoragwo na ũgucania mũnene wa arĩmĩ arũme na arĩmĩ atumia, mĩcemanio ya mwanya ya ithomo kana mĩbango ngũrani ya gũikara ya arĩmĩ arũme na arĩmĩ atumia nĩ yagĩrĩirũo kũrũmagĩrĩrũo.

sentences.source: and agronomic practices used in their villages.
sentences.translation: na mĩtugo ya ũrĩmi ĩrĩa ĩhũthĩrĩtwo matũũra-inĩ mao.
sentences.reference: na mĩtugo ya ũrĩmi ĩrĩa ĩhũthagĩrwo  matũũrainĩ mao.

sentences.source: Good quality and appropriate seed varieties are essential for the growth of strong and healthy crops that are resistant to diseases and even drought.
sentences.translation: Mĩthemba mĩega ya mbeũ na ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire nĩ ya bata harĩ kũgĩa na mĩmera mĩega na ĩrĩ na ũgima mwega ya kũhiũrania na mĩrimũ na o na ng'aragu.
sentences.reference: Mĩthemba mĩega ya mbegũ na ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire nĩ ĩri bata harĩ gũkũria mĩmera mĩega ĩtangĩgũmĩrwo nĩ mĩrimũ kana waagi wa mbura

sentences.source: Prompting questions: Why is it important to use appropriate seed variety?
sentences.translation: Ciũria cia bata: Nĩkĩ nĩ ũndũ wa bata kũhũthĩra mbeũ cia mĩthemba ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire?
sentences.reference: Ciũria cia gũtaara: Nĩkĩi harĩ bata kũhũthĩra mbegũ mĩthemba ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire?

sentences.source: Demo plots will facilitate in selection of maize seed varieties to be adopted.
sentences.translation: Mĩbango ya kwĩmenyeria nĩ ĩgũtũteithia gũthuura mĩthemba ya mbegũ cia ngũrwe ĩrĩa ĩgakorũo ĩkĩhũthĩrũo.
sentences.reference: Mĩgũnda ya kũgereria nĩ ĩgũteithĩrĩria gũthuura mbegũ cia mbembe iria ĩrĩhũthagĩrwo.

sentences.source: Below are a number of questions which the technical adviser can ask the VBAs in order to get an overview of contemporary agricultural practices in the area.
sentences.translation: Thĩinĩ wa gĩcunjĩ kĩrĩa kĩrũmĩrĩire, nĩ kũrĩ na ciũria imwe iria mũtabania wa tekinoronjĩ angĩkũria VBA nĩgetha ahingũre maũndũ megiĩ mĩtugo ya ũrĩmi ya mahinda maya thĩinĩ wa gĩcigo kĩu.
sentences.reference: Haha mũhuro nĩ ciũria imwe iria [cs] technical adviser [cs]  angĩũria [cs]VBA [cs]  nĩguo amenye ũrĩa ũrĩmi ũratwarithio mĩgũndainĩ gicigo kĩu

sentences.source: Learning outcomes: Understand the importance of using the appropriate seed variety.
sentences.translation: Moimĩrĩro ma kwĩruta: Nĩ ũkuona bata wa kũhũthĩra mbeũ cia mĩthemba ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire.
sentences.reference: Maumĩrĩra ma gĩthomo: kũmenya bata wa kuhũthĩra mĩthemba ya mbegũ iria ciagĩrĩire

sentences.source: Door-to-door registration of their neighbours.
sentences.translation: Kũmenyeria andũ a itũũra rĩao mũrango na mũrango.
sentences.reference: Wandĩkithia wa nyũmba  o nyũmba  wa andũ arĩa marigainie

sentences.source: Learning objectives: establish the existing agronomic practices.
sentences.translation: Muoroto wa gĩthomo: kũhingia mĩtugo ya ũrĩmi ĩrĩa ĩrĩ kuo.
sentences.reference: Maumĩrĩra ma gĩthomo: kũhanda kwĩmenyeria  mĩtugo ya ũrĩmi ĩrĩa ĩ kuo

sentences.source: What is the current spacing?
sentences.translation: Kĩara kĩa mahinda maya nĩ kĩrĩkũ?
sentences.reference: Mũtaganĩrie wa rĩu nĩ ũrĩkũ?

sentences.source: Hybrid seeds are usually area-specific since different places have different altitude and rainfall conditions.
sentences.translation: Kaingĩ mbeũ cia mũthemba wa hybrid nĩ cia mwanya tondũ kũndũ gũtiganĩte nĩ kũrĩ ũraihu wa igũrũ na mbura.
sentences.reference: Mbegũ ĩtarĩ cia ũndũire ĩhandagwo icigo itiganĩte ũraihu wa igũrũ na thĩ hamwe na mũigana wa mbura

sentences.source: The economic costs of climate change on agriculture are estimated at 2.6% of GDP.
sentences.translation: Mbeca cia ũthii wa na mbere cia mogarũrũku ma rĩera-inĩ harĩ ũrĩmi nĩ igĩtĩkĩrĩka gũkorũo na 2,6% ya GDP.
sentences.reference: ngarama ya ũcenjia wa rĩera ũrĩmi-inĩ ũtarĩirwo gũkorwo ũrĩ   gĩcunjĩ kĩa igĩrĩ tũrũmo ithathatũ kwa igana ya ũtonga wa Kenya (GDP)

sentences.source: Agriculture in Kenya dominates the economy, contributing significantly to GDP.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi wa Kenya nĩ ũtongoragia ũtonga, na nĩ ũteithagia GDP mũno.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi bũrũri wa Kenya nĩ mũnene na nĩwongagĩrĩra ũkũria wa ũtonga wa bũrũri (GDP)

sentences.source: Agricultural cooperatives play a significant role in Kenya’s rural economy.
sentences.translation: Ikundi cia ũrĩmi nĩ ikoragwo na itemi inene harĩ ũthii wa na mbere wa bũrũri wa Kenya.
sentences.reference: Ikundi cia ũrĩmi nĩirutaga wĩra wa bata harĩ ũkũria wa matũra bũrũriinĩ wa Kenya

sentences.source: The county’s farmers are actively involved in cooperative societies to market their produce.
sentences.translation: Arimi a gĩcigo kĩu nĩ makoragwo na mĩbango mĩingĩ ya kũheana indo ciao.
sentences.reference: Ngwatanĩro cia arĩmi a kauntĩ nĩmarahũkĩte kwendia magetha hamwe.

sentences.source: Proper storage methods help prevent farm produce from spoiling before reaching the market.
sentences.translation: Njĩra njega ya kũiga indo cia mũgũnda nĩ ĩteithagia kũgirĩrĩria indo cia mũgũnda cianangĩke itanakinya thoko-inĩ.
sentences.reference: ũigi mwega  wa magetha thitooinĩ nĩũgiragĩrĩria mathũke matanendio

sentences.source: Organic matter improves soil structure for carrots.
sentences.translation: Ũmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩ mĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩ mĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩ mĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩ mĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩ mĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩ mĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩmĩ
sentences.reference: Mborera nĩnoragia tĩĩri harĩ ũkũria wa karati

sentences.source: Nyandarua’s agricultural landscape is dotted with greenhouses growing a variety of vegetables.
sentences.translation: Thĩinĩ wa mĩgũnda ya Nyandarua nĩ kũrĩ mĩgũnda mĩingĩ ya mĩthabibũ ya mĩthemba mĩingĩ.
sentences.reference:
Mĩgũnda  ya Nyandarua kũrĩa  kũhandagwo mboga mĩthemba na mĩthemba  
  nĩiri nyũmba nyĩngĩ  iria cigaga ũrugarĩ, heho,  maaĩ  na kũgitĩra tũtambi

sentences.source: Farmers must comply with food safety regulations for carrot sales.
sentences.translation: Arimi magĩrĩirũo kũhingia mawatho ma ũgitĩri wa irio harĩ kwendia karoti.
sentences.reference: No mũhaka arĩmi marũmĩrĩre mawatho ma ũgitĩri wa irio kũri wendia wa karati

sentences.source: Kenya’s agricultural sector faces challenges like climate change and overreliance on rain-fed farming.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi wa Kenya ũcemanagia na moritũ ta mogarũrũku ma rĩera-inĩ na kwĩhoka mũno ũrĩmi wa mbura.
sentences.reference: ũrĩmi nĩũrathogwo nĩ ũcenjia wa rĩera na ũrĩmĩ wĩhocĩtie mbũra mũno

sentences.source: Regular feeding and care of livestock ensure animals remain healthy and productive.
sentences.translation: Kũheana irio na kũrũmbũiya mahiũ hĩndĩ ciothe nĩ gũtũmaga mahiũ makorũo marĩ na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ na magĩe na moimĩrĩro mega.
sentences.reference: kũhe mahiũ irio hĩndĩ ciothe na ũmenyereri mwega nĩũtũmaga mahiu magie na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ na kũgia maciaro mega.

sentences.source: Cabbage prefers temperatures between 15°C and 20°C.
sentences.translation: Gĩkũyũ nĩ gĩthuuraga ũrugarĩ wa gatagatĩ ka 15°C na 20°C.
sentences.reference: Kabici yendaga ũrugarĩ  wa  centigrade ikũmi na ithano nginya mĩrongo ĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Protecting crops from pests and diseases is essential for a successful harvest .
sentences.translation: Kũgitĩra mĩmera kuuma kũrĩ mĩrimũ na mĩrimũ nĩ kwa bata harĩ kũgĩa na magetha mega .
sentences.reference: Kũgitĩra mĩmera kuumana na mĩrimũ na tũtambi nĩ  ũndũ wa bata harĩ kũgaacĩra magetha.

sentences.source: Farmers need enter to local and international markets to sell their harvested produce.
sentences.translation: Arimi nĩ marabatara kũingĩra ithandũkũ-inĩ rĩa bũrũri na rĩa mabũrũri mangĩ nĩguo mahũthĩre indo ciao.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi nĩ mabataraga kũingĩra thoko-inĩ cia bũrũri na cia mabũrũri ma nja nĩguo mahote kwendia magetha mao.

sentences.source: A clean farm keeps livestock safe from diseases.
sentences.translation: Mũgũnda mũtheru nĩ ũgitagĩra mahiũ kuumana na mĩrimũ.
sentences.reference: Mũgũnda mũtheru  nĩ ũgitagĩra mahiũ kuumana na mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Farmers protect livestock from diseases by keeping them clean.
sentences.translation: Arimi nĩ maragitagĩra mahiũ kuuma kũrĩ mĩrimũ na njĩra ya kũmaiga marĩ matheru.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi nĩmagitagĩra mahiũ   kuumana na mĩrimũ nĩ kũmaiga marĩa matheru.

sentences.source: We plant our seeds during the rainy season to ensure good growth and harvest.
sentences.translation: Tũhaandaga mbeũ ciitũ hĩndĩ ya mbura nĩ getha tũgĩe na ũgwati mwega wa gũkũra na kũgetha.
sentences.reference: Tũhaandaga mbegũ hĩndĩ ya mbura nĩguo ikũre wega na tũgĩe na magetha mega.

sentences.source: The county’s farmers are increasingly using organic fertilizers to maintain soil health.
sentences.translation: Arimi a gĩcigo kĩu nĩ mathiaga na mbere kũhũthĩra mĩmera ya mĩmera kũgitĩra ũgima wa mĩgũnda.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi a kaunti  nĩmararĩma  makĩhũthĩra mũno thumu wa gũtũria tĩri.

sentences.source: Farmers harvest their crops during the dry season when the fields are dry.
sentences.translation: Arimi magethaga mĩgũnda yao hĩndĩ ya ng'aragu.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi magethaga irio hĩndĩ ya riũa rĩrĩa mĩgũnda ĩrĩ mĩũmũ.

sentences.source: Good weather conditions, including sunshine and rain, help farmers produce abundant crops.
sentences.translation: Rĩera rĩega, hamwe na riũa na mbura, nĩ itũmaga arĩmi magĩe na irio nyingĩ.
sentences.reference: Rĩera rĩega  riũa na mbura nĩ iteithagia arĩmi kũgĩa na magetha maingĩ.

sentences.source: Kenya’s agricultural sector is crucial for national development and food security.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi wa Kenya nĩ wa bata mũno harĩ ũthii wa na mbere wa bũrũri na ũgitĩri wa irio.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi Kenya  wĩ bata harĩ ũkũria wa bũrũri na ũgitĩri wa wagi wa irio.

sentences.source: Cattle manure helps the field to grow good crops.
sentences.translation: Mĩtĩ ya mahiũ nĩ ĩteithagia mũgũnda ũcio kũgĩa na mĩmera mĩega.
sentences.reference: Thũmũ ya mahiũ nĩ ũteithagia mũgũnda gũkũria magetha mega.

sentences.source: Farmers raise chickens for eggs, which they sell in the market.
sentences.translation: Arĩmi nĩ makoragwo na ngũkũ cia kũgũra maya, na nĩ ciendagio thoko-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi a ngũkũ marĩithagia  ngũkũ nĩũndũ  wa matũmbi marĩa mendagia thokoinĩ.

sentences.source: A well-fed cow produces more milk for the farmer.
sentences.translation: Ng'ombe ĩrĩa ĩheagwo irio njega nĩ ĩheaga mũrĩmi ũũkĩ mũingĩ.
sentences.reference: Mũrĩmi nĩakamaga iria rĩingĩ rĩrĩa ng’ombe ĩhũnĩte.

sentences.source: Favorable weather and government subsidies have boosted agricultural productivity in Kenya recently.
sentences.translation: Rĩera rĩega na ũteithio wa thirikari nĩ ciongereire ũtonga wa ũrĩmi bũrũri-inĩ wa Kenya ica ikuhĩ.
sentences.reference: Rĩera rĩega na ũteithio wa thirikari nĩũgacĩrĩirie  maciaro ũrĩminĩ  bũrũri wa Kenya.

sentences.source: Container gardening allows for growing carrots in limited spaces.
sentences.translation: Kũhaanda mĩgũnda ya indo cia kwandĩka nĩ kũhotithagia kũhaanda karoti handũ harĩa hatarĩ na mĩgũnda mĩingĩ.
sentences.reference: Kurima makũniainĩ nĩkũhotithagia mũrĩmi gũkũria karati handũ harĩ mwaramo mũnini.

sentences.source: Crowded cabbage heads are more prone to diseases.
sentences.translation: Andũ aingĩ nĩ makoragwo na mĩrimũ mĩingĩ mũno.
sentences.reference: kabici ndumanu nocigũmĩrwo nĩ mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Farmers often sell surplus crops in local markets to earn income
sentences.translation: Nĩ ũndũ wa kũgĩa na mbeca, arĩmi kaingĩ nĩ mendete kũendia mĩgũnda-inĩ ya kwao mbeũ iria ciongerereka
sentences.reference: Kaingĩ arĩmi nĩ mendagia magetha marĩa matigarĩte thoko-inĩ cia hakuhĩ  nĩguo magĩe mbeca nyingĩ.

sentences.source: Chickens provide eggs and meat, important for family meals.
sentences.translation: Ngũkũ nĩ ciĩheaga nyama na maya, na nĩ cia bata harĩ irio cia famĩlĩ.
sentences.reference: Ngũkũ iheanaga matumbi na nyama iria irĩ bata irio inĩ cia bamĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Sunlight provides plants with energy, which is necessary for photosynthesis and growth.
sentences.translation: Ũtheri wa riũa nĩ ũheaga mĩmera hinya, ũrĩa ũbataranagia nĩguo mĩmera ĩthiĩ na mbere gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Ũtheri wa riũa ũheaga mĩmera hinya ũrĩa ũbataranagia nĩguo ithondeke irio na ikũre.

sentences.source: Farmers build strong fences to protect livestock from wild animals.
sentences.translation: Arĩmi nĩ mathondekagia thingo cia hinya cia kũgitĩra mahiũ kuuma kũrĩ nyamũ cia gĩthaka.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi nĩmakaga ngiri nũmu  nĩ kũgitĩra mahiũ kuumana  na nyamũ cia gĩthaka.

sentences.source: Kenya is a leading producer of tea and coffee, vital for its economy.
sentences.translation: Kenya nĩ ĩkoragwo ĩrĩ mũũmbi mũnene wa cai na cai, na nĩ ĩkoragwo ĩrĩ ya bata harĩ ũtonga wayo.
sentences.reference: Kenya nĩtongorĩtie harĩ ũrimi wa cai na kahũa, ũrĩa ũri bata harĩ ũkũria wa bũrũri.

sentences.source: Healthy animals need clean water and enough food every day.
sentences.translation: Nyamũ iria irĩ na ũgima wa mwĩrĩ nĩ ciendaga maaĩ matheru na irio nyingĩ o mũthenya.
sentences.reference: Nyamũ irĩ ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ nĩ ibataraga maĩ matheru na irio cia kũigana o mũthenya.

sentences.source: Agriculture creates employment opportunities, especially in rural areas where farming is common.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi nĩ ũheaga andũ mĩeke ya kũgĩa na mawĩra, makĩria kũrĩa kũrĩ mĩgũnda ya mĩgũnda.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi nĩ ũheaga andũ wĩra, na makĩria icagi-inĩ kũrĩa ũrĩmi nĩ mũingĩ.

sentences.source: Cows provide milk and meat for the farmers to consume and sell.
sentences.translation: Ng'ombe nĩ ciheaga arimi iria na nyama cia kũrĩa na cia kũendia.
sentences.reference: Ng'ombe nĩ iheaga arĩmi iria na nyama cia kũrĩa na kwendia.

sentences.source: Kenya’s agricultural sector is adapting to new challenges and opportunities.
sentences.translation: Mũthi wa ũrĩmi wa Kenya nĩ ũracemania na moritũ na mieke njerũ.
sentences.reference: Rũhonge rwa ũrĩmi Kenya nĩrũrahĩmbĩria ũrĩmi na matanya ma kĩrĩu.

sentences.source: Kenya’s tea production remains a major contributor to its agricultural exports.
sentences.translation: Ũmĩmĩmi wa ndibei wa Kenya no ũkorũo ũrĩ wa bata mũno harĩ kũrutithania indo cia ũrĩmi.
sentences.reference: ũkũria wa cai Kenya ũtigarĩtĩ ũri gĩcangĩro kĩnene hari indo iria ciendagio na nja cia ũrĩmi

sentences.source: Climate change poses significant challenges to Kenya’s agricultural sector.
sentences.translation: Kũgarũrũka kwa rĩera-inĩ kũrehaga moritũ manene harĩ gĩcigo kĩa ũrĩmi kĩa Kenya.
sentences.reference: ũcenjia wa rĩera nĩ ũrehaga mathĩna ũrĩmi-inĩ

sentences.source: Farmers sell livestock to make money for other farm needs.
sentences.translation: Arimi nĩ mahũraga mahiũ nĩguo makorũo na mbeca cia kũgũra indo ingĩ.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi mendagia mahiũ nĩguo mone mbeca cia kũgũra indo ingĩ cia ũremi.

sentences.source: Nyandarua’s agricultural sector plays a crucial role in ensuring food security in Kenya.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi wa Nyandarua ũkoragwo na itemi inene harĩ kũmenyeria ũgitĩri wa irio bũrũri-inĩ wa Kenya.
sentences.reference: Ruhonge rwa ũrimi  Nyandarua   nĩ  ũri   bata mũno nĩũndũ wa  gũtigĩrĩra atĩ kwĩna irio ciakũigana Kenya

sentences.source: Farmers breed strong animals to improve livestock quality.
sentences.translation: Arimi nĩ maciaraga mahiũ marĩ na hinya nĩguo magĩe na ũhoti wa kũmenyeria mahiũ mao.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi  maciarithanagia mahiu nigetha maagirie mahiu.

sentences.source: Kenya’s tea production reached 500 thousand tons in 2018.
sentences.translation: Mwaka-inĩ wa 2018, indo cia kũnyua ndibei bũrũri-inĩ wa Kenya nĩ ciakinyire ngiri magana matano.
sentences.reference: ũkũria wa macani  Kenya wakinyire tani ngiri magana matano mwaka wa ngiri igĩrĩ na ikũmi na inyanya.

sentences.source: Kenya’s agricultural sector is adapting to new technologies and practices.
sentences.translation: Mũthi wa ũrĩmi wa Kenya nĩ ũraregana na thekinoronjĩ njerũ na mĩtugo mĩerũ.
sentences.reference: Rũhonge rwa ũrĩmi  Kenya  nĩ ũraiyũkia teknoronji  njerũ na ũrĩmi wa kĩrĩu

sentences.source: The country faces challenges in agricultural productivity due to limited arable land.
sentences.translation: Bũrũri ũcio nĩ ũcemanagia na moritũ ma ũthii wa na mbere wa ũrĩmi nĩ ũndũ wa mĩgũnda mĩnini ya kũhanda.
sentences.reference: Bũrũri nĩ ũkoretwo na mathĩna ũhoro ũkoniĩ  ũrĩmi nĩũndũ wa ũnyihu wa mĩgũnda.

sentences.source: The country is the third-leading exporter of fresh produce globally.
sentences.translation: Bũrũri ũyũ nĩ guo ũtwarithia wa gatatũ mũnene wa indo iria ithondeketwo thĩ yothe.
sentences.reference: Bũrũri niguo wa gatatũ ũtongoragia  hari wendia wa maciaro thĩ yothe

sentences.source: Farmers must watch animals closely to see if they are sick.
sentences.translation: Arimi magĩrĩirũo kũrora nyamũ wega nĩguo mamenye kana nĩ irũaru.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi no mũhaka mamenyerere mahiũ matikanyitwo nĩ mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Livestock can provide income when sold at the market.
sentences.translation: Mĩgũnda ya mahiũ no ĩgĩe na mbeca rĩrĩa ĩrehagwo thoko-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Mahiũ no marehe  ũtonga  rĩrĩa mendio thokoinĩ.

sentences.source: Kenya’s agriculture sector is crucial for rural development and poverty reduction.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi wa Kenya nĩ wa bata mũno harĩ ũthii wa na mbere wa mĩgũnda na kũniina ũthĩni.
sentences.reference: Rũhonge rwa ũrĩmi nĩrwabata harĩ ũthii wa nambere na kũnyihia ũkĩa Kenya.

sentences.source: Farmers keep records of livestock to track their growth and health.
sentences.translation: Arĩmi nĩ marĩkoragwo na rekodi cia mahiũ mao nĩguo marũmĩrĩre ũrĩa makũraga na ũrĩa makoragwo na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi nĩ mandikaga  rekondi cia mahiũ  nigetha  mamenye ũrĩa mahiu marakũra na ũgima.

sentences.source: Good care of livestock helps increase farm income.
sentences.translation: Kũmenyerera mahiũ wega nĩ gũtũmaga mbeca cia arĩmi ciongerereke.
sentences.reference: Kumenyerera  mahiũ wega nĩ gũteithagia arĩmi kũongerera ũtonga.

sentences.source: Kenya’s major agricultural exports include tea, coffee, cut flowers, and vegetables.
sentences.translation: Bũrũri wa Kenya ũrutithanagia indo nyingĩ cia mũgũnda wa mĩthabibũ ta ndibei, cai, mĩmera, na mĩmera.
sentences.reference: Maciaro ma mĩgunda kuuma Kenya marĩa mendagio  mũno mabũrũri ma nja nĩ macani, kahũa,  mahũa na mĩthemba ya  mboga

sentences.source: Kenya’s dairy sector is one of the largest in sub-Saharan Africa.
sentences.translation: Ng'ombe cia iria cia Kenya nĩ ĩmwe ya iria nene mũno bũrũri-inĩ wa Afrika mũhuro wa Sahara.
sentences.reference: Rũhonge rwa iria Kenya nĩrũmwe rwa marĩa manene (cs) Sub-Saharan Afrika

sentences.source: The government is promoting irrigation to reduce dependence on rain-fed agriculture.
sentences.translation: Thirikari nĩ ĩrathiĩ na mbere kũrehe ũrigithathi nĩ getha ĩgĩe na muoroto wa kũniina ũrigithathi wa mĩgũnda ĩrĩa ĩheagwo irio cia mbura.
sentences.reference: Thirikari  nĩ  ĩrambatĩria ũrimi wa maĩ nĩũndũ wa kũnyihia kwĩhoka ũrĩmi wa mbura.

sentences.source: Agriculture is the backbone of Kenya’s economy, employing 70% of the rural population.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi nĩguo mũthingi wa ũthii wa na mbere wa bũrũri wa Kenya, na nĩ ũrutaga wĩra harĩ andũ 70% arĩa matũũraga mĩgũnda-inĩ.
sentences.reference: ũrĩmi nĩguo  wĩra ũrĩa mũnene na nĩ wandĩkĩte andũ mĩrongo mũgwanja harĩ igana Kenya.

sentences.source: Kenya is a leading producer of tea, coffee, and fresh vegetables.
sentences.translation: Kenya nĩyo ĩtongoragia mũno harĩ kũruta cai, cai, na mĩmera mĩhũmũ.
sentences.reference: Kenya niyo ĩtongoretie harĩ ũkũria wa macani, kahũa na mboga mĩthema mĩthemba.

sentences.source: The government is promoting agricultural practices to protect the environment.
sentences.translation: Thirikari nĩ ĩratwarithia na mbere maũndũ ma ũrĩmi nĩguo ĩgitĩre mũthiũrũrũko.
sentences.reference: Thirikari nĩirambatĩrĩria ũrĩmi  mwega nĩguo kũgitĩra marĩa matũrigicĩirie.

sentences.source: Carrots need sunlight all day to grow strong and produce good roots.
sentences.translation: Maragareti nĩ mabataraga ũtheri wa riũa mũthenya wothe nĩguo makũre marĩ na hinya na magĩe na mĩri mĩega.
sentences.reference: Karati nĩ ibataraga ũtheri wa riũa mũthenya wothe nĩguo ĩgĩe na mĩri mĩega.

sentences.source: The government is supporting agricultural cooperatives to enhance farmer productivity.
sentences.translation: Thirikari nĩ ĩteithagia kambuni cia ũrĩmi kũongerera ũtonga wa arĩmi.
sentences.reference: Thirikari nĩĩranyitĩrĩra ikundi cia ũrĩmi nĩgetha  kũongerereke  maciaro ma arĩmi

sentences.source: Small-scale farmers in Kenya grow maize, beans, potatoes, and bananas.
sentences.translation: Arĩmi anini bũrũri-inĩ wa Kenya nĩ marimaga ng'ombe, mbegũ, mĩgate, na njũng'wa.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi anini Kenya makũragia mbembe, mboco, waru na marigu.

sentences.source: The dairy sector contributes 4% to Kenya’s GDP.
sentences.translation: Ng'anda ya iria nĩ ĩrutaga 4% ya GDP ya Kenya.
sentences.reference: Rũhonge rwa iria rũcangagĩra gĩcunje kĩa inya harĩ igana ya ũtonga wa Kenya  [cs](GDP).

sentences.source: The government is investing in irrigation to boost agricultural production.
sentences.translation: Thirikari nĩ ĩgĩteithia na ũrigithathi nĩguo ĩongerere ũthii wa na mbere wa ũrĩmi.
sentences.reference: Thirikari nĩraigithia ũrĩmi-inĩ wa maĩ kwambatĩria maciaro ma ũrĩmi

sentences.source: Cabbage needs full sunlight for proper growth.
sentences.translation: Ng'ombe nĩ ĩbataraga ũtheri wa riũa mũingĩ nĩguo ikũre wega.
sentences.reference: kabici yendaga   riũa nĩguo  ĩkũre wega.

sentences.source: Cabbage seeds are sown in seedbeds first.
sentences.translation: Mbegũ cia mbegũ ciambagĩrĩrio mĩgũnda-inĩ ya mbegũ.
sentences.reference: mbegũ cia kabici ciamambaga kuhurwo.

sentences.source: Add compost to the soil to help carrots grow larger and healthier.
sentences.translation: Wĩra wa kũiga mbegũ thĩ nĩ wa gũteithia mbegũ ikũre na igĩe na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ.
sentences.reference: Ongerera thũmũ mũgũnda-inĩ nĩ ũndũ wa gũteithĩrĩria karati gũkũra na ũgima mwega.

sentences.source: Small farms in Kenya also produce beans, peas, and chillies.
sentences.translation: O na kũrĩ ũguo, arĩmi anini bũrũri-inĩ wa Kenya nĩ maciaraga mbegũ, mbegũ, na mĩguĩ.
sentences.reference: Ona mĩgũnda mĩnini Kenya nĩkũragia mboco, minji, na biribiri

sentences.source: mulching helps to retain soil moisture.
sentences.translation: Gũthondeka mĩmera nĩ gũtũmaga thĩ ĩkorũo ĩrĩ na ũrugarĩ.
sentences.reference: Kũhumbĩra tĩri na mahuti gũteithagia kũiga ũgunyu.

sentences.source: Store cabbage in cold storage for longer freshness.
sentences.translation: Gĩkũyũ kĩigĩrũo icunjĩ-inĩ cia kũrigĩrĩria nĩguo kĩgĩe na ũrugarĩ wa ihinda iraya.
sentences.reference: Iga kabici  handũ hatarĩ  na urugari   nĩgetha ciikarange itagũthũka.

sentences.source: The government is promoting agricultural research to enhance productivity.
sentences.translation: Thirikari nĩ ĩrathiĩ na mbere na ũthuthuria wa ũrĩmi nĩguo ĩongerere ũthii wa na mbere.
sentences.reference: Thirikari nĩraendekithia ũthuthuria wa ũrĩmi kwagĩria maciaro

sentences.source: Proper irrigation ensures healthy, uniform cabbage heads.
sentences.translation: Kũhũũrwo wega kwa maaĩ nĩ gũtũmaga mũtwe wa ng'ombe ũkorũo ũrĩ mwega na ũrĩ mũigananĩru.
sentences.reference: Gũitĩrĩria maĩ wega gũtũmaga kabici  ĩkorwo cĩganaine.

sentences.source: Early maturing varieties help avoid harsh weather conditions.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩrakũra tene nĩ ĩteithagia gwĩthema mĩrimũ mĩũru.
sentences.reference: Mĩthemba ĩrĩa ĩkũrangaga nĩĩteithagia kũrĩra rĩera rĩũru.

sentences.source: Farmers add manure to boost cabbage yields.
sentences.translation: Arĩmi nĩ maathondekagia kĩronda nĩguo magĩe na maciaro maingĩ.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi mongagĩrĩra thumu  nĩguo kwongerera maciaro ma kabici.

sentences.source: Carrots are rich in vitamins A and K.
sentences.translation: Karoti nĩ irĩ na vitamini A na K.
sentences.reference: Karati nĩikoragwo na bitameni nyingĩ  cia A na K.

sentences.source: Weeds can compete with crops for nutrients and water.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera no ĩringithanio na mĩmera nĩ ũndũ wa irio na maaĩ.
sentences.reference: Riia rĩhĩtahĩtanaga gũtunya mĩmera [cs]nutrients[cs] na maĩ

sentences.source: Irrigation is crucial during dry periods
sentences.translation: Kũrigia nĩ kwa bata mũno hĩndĩ ya ũrugarĩ
sentences.reference: gũitĩrĩria maĩ nĩ kũri bata hĩndĩ ĩrĩa kwarĩte.

sentences.source: Crop rotation reduces the risk of disease and pest.
sentences.translation: Kũgarũrũka kwa mĩmera nĩ gũtũmaga ũgwati wa kũgĩa na mĩrimũ na mĩrimũ wongerereke.
sentences.reference: gũcenjania mĩmera kũnyihagia ũgwati wa mĩrimũ na tũtambi.

sentences.source: Too much heat can cause cabbage heads to crack.
sentences.translation: Kũgĩa na ũrugarĩ mũingĩ mũno no gũtũme mũtwe wa ndigiri ũtheremo.
sentences.reference: ũrugarĩ mũingĩ no ũtũme   kabici ciatũke.

sentences.source: Processed forms include juices and canned products.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩtheretio nĩ mĩthemba ĩkoragwo na mĩthemba ya mĩmera na indo iria ciathondekwo.
sentences.reference: Irio ithondeketwo igereirio maciniinĩ ta mai na irio cia mĩkebe

sentences.source: Also use green manures for cabbage farming.
sentences.translation: Ningĩ no ũhũthĩre mĩmera mĩruru ya kũrĩma.
sentences.reference: no ũhũthĩre thumu wa mĩmera ũrĩminĩ wa kabici.

sentences.source: Harvest cabbage early in the morning.
sentences.translation: Tũrutaga ndigiri rũcinĩ tene.
sentences.reference: Getha kabici rũcinĩ tene.

sentences.source: You can plant carrots either by sowing seeds straight into the soil, or transplant seedlings that were started in another location.
sentences.translation: No ũhaande karoti na njĩra ya kũhaanda mbeũ thĩinĩ wa tĩĩri, kana ũhaande mbeũ iria ciambĩrĩirie kũhaanda handũ harĩa hangĩ.
sentences.reference: No ũhande karati na njĩra ya kũhura kana kũhanda tũmĩmera twahurĩtwo.

sentences.source: Carrots are harvested by gently pulling from the soil.
sentences.translation: Maragareti macookanagio na njĩra ya kũgũtha kuuma tĩĩri-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Karati igethagwo na gũcigũcia kahora kuma tĩriinĩ.

sentences.source: They requires consistent moisture during the growing season.
sentences.translation: Mabataraga kũnyua wega hĩndĩ ya kũrĩma.
sentences.reference: Nĩ ciendaga ũgunyu mũingĩ hĩndĩ ĩrĩa irakũra.

sentences.source: Harvest cabbage when heads are firm.
sentences.translation: Gũthuna ndigithũ rĩrĩa mũtwe ũrĩ na hinya.
sentences.reference: Getha kabici yakũra wega

sentences.source: Compost improves soil fertility for cabbage farming.
sentences.translation: Kombuti nĩ ĩteithagia mĩgũnda kũgĩa na mbeũ nyingĩ.
sentences.reference: Thumu nĩ wongagĩrĩra ũnoru wa tĩri ũrĩminĩ wa kabici.

sentences.source: Farmers use organic pesticides to control pests.
sentences.translation: Arimi nĩ mahũthagĩra ndawa cia gũtharĩkĩra mĩmera.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi mahũthagĩra dawa kũingata tũtambi.

sentences.source: Well-timed planting leads to higher yields.
sentences.translation: Kũhaanda hĩndĩ ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire nĩ kũrehaga maciaro maingĩ.
sentences.reference: Kũhanda ihinda rĩrĩa rĩagĩrĩire kũrehaga maciaro maingĩ.

sentences.source: Harvest carrots when they reach desired size.
sentences.translation: Thurai karoti rĩrĩa ciakinya mũigana ũrĩa ũrabatarania.
sentences.reference: Getha karati rĩrĩa ciakũra.

sentences.source: They require consistent moisture throughout their growth.
sentences.translation: Nĩ mabataraga ũrugarĩ mũiganaine hĩndĩ ĩrĩa yothe marakũra.
sentences.reference: Ciendaga ũgunyu hĩndĩ ĩrĩa   irakũra.

sentences.source: Nitrogen-rich fertilizers promote healthy carrot tops.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩkoragwo na nitrojeni nĩ ĩteithagia andũ magĩe na mĩmera mĩega ya karoti.
sentences.reference: Bataraitha ĩna [cs] nitrogen [cs] nyingĩ  nĩ ĩteithagia ũgima mwega wa mahuti ma karati.

sentences.source: Pull out extra carrot plants to give the others space
sentences.translation: Tũma mĩmera ĩngĩ ya karoti nĩguo ĩhe andũ arĩa angĩ handũ
sentences.reference: Munya mĩmera ĩmwe ya karati nĩgetha kũgie na handũ ha mĩmera ĩyo ĩngĩ gũkũra wega.

sentences.source: Carrots can be planted in both spring and fall.
sentences.translation: Mĩtĩ ya karoti no ĩhandwo o hĩndĩ ya kĩririkano na hĩndĩ ya ũrugarĩ.
sentences.reference: Karati no ihandwo mbura  yambĩrĩria kana ĩkiura.

sentences.source: Test soil pH before planting carrots.
sentences.translation: Geria pH ya tĩĩri mbere ya kũhaanda karoti.
sentences.reference: Thima ũrũrũ wa tĩri ũtana handa karati.

sentences.source: Seeds are sown directly into the garden soil.
sentences.translation: Mbegũ ciĩhaandaga ĩmwe kwa ĩmwe thĩinĩ wa mũgũnda.
sentences.reference: Mbegu ihandagwo o rĩmwe tĩrinĩ

sentences.source: Proper storage practices ensure cabbage quality is maintained after harvest.
sentences.translation: Mĩtugo ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire ya gũthondekwo nĩ ĩronania atĩ kabegũ nĩ gakoragwo na mũtaratara mwega thutha wa kũgetha.
sentences.reference: Kũiga kabici wega nĩkũmenyagĩrĩra gĩkĩro thutha wa kũgethwo.

sentences.source: Carrots grow best in loose, well-drained soil with plenty of sunlight.
sentences.translation: Karuta nĩ gakũraga wega mũno thĩinĩ wa ithaka irĩ na ũrugarĩ na irĩ na ũtheri mũingĩ wa riũa.
sentences.reference: Karati ikũraga wega tĩri-inĩ ũtagaga ũgunyu na riũa

sentences.source: Carrots grow well in well-drained, loose soil.
sentences.translation: Karuta nĩ gakũraga wega thĩinĩ wa tĩĩri ũtarĩ na maaĩ maingĩ.
sentences.reference: Karati ĩkũraga wega  kũndũ gũtarahaga maĩ

sentences.source: Water carrots regularly to prevent them from becoming woody.
sentences.translation: Thimaga karoti kaingĩ nĩguo itigatuĩke cia mĩtĩ.
sentences.reference: Ĩtagirĩria karati maĩ kaingĩ nĩgetha itikome

sentences.source: Carrots require good soil preparation before planting.
sentences.translation: Mĩtĩ ya karoti nĩ ĩrabatara kũhaarĩrio wega mbere ya kũhaanda.
sentences.reference: Karati yendaga tĩri ũharĩrio wega ĩtanahandwo.

sentences.source: Red cabbage and green cabbage are common varieties.
sentences.translation: Kĩrĩnyaga gĩtheru na gĩtheru nĩ mĩthemba mĩingĩ.
sentences.reference: kabici ndune na ya ngiriini nĩyo mĩthemba ĩrĩa yonekanaga kaingĩ.

sentences.source: Spring planting gives an early cabbage harvest.
sentences.translation: Kũhaanda mbeũ hĩndĩ ya gĩthurano nĩ gũtũmaga kũgĩe na magetha ma kabegũ ka mbere.
sentences.reference: Kũhanda kabici mbura ĩkĩambĩrĩria nĩ gũtũmaga ĩgethwo tene.

sentences.source: Carrots can be grown in cool climates.
sentences.translation: Karuta no gakũre kũndũ kũrĩ na ũrugarĩ.
sentences.reference: Karati no ikũrio kũndũ kũhehu

sentences.source: Carrots take about two to three months to fully mature for harvesting.
sentences.translation: Maragareti mathiaga ihinda rĩa mĩeri ĩĩrĩ kana ĩtatũ mbere ya kũng'a.
sentences.reference: Karati  ikũraga ihinda rĩa mĩeri ĩĩrĩ kana ĩtatũ.

sentences.source: Farmers use organic methods to reduce environmental impact.
sentences.translation: Arimi nĩ mahũthagĩra njĩra cia mũthiithũ wa mĩthiithũ kũniina moimĩrĩro ma mũthiithũ wa mũthiithũ.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi mahũthagĩra thumu nĩguo  manyihie ũthũkangu wa rĩera.

sentences.source: Carrots need full sunlight for optimal development.
sentences.translation: Marago nĩ mabataraga ũtheri wa riũa mũingĩ nĩguo magĩe na mogarũrũku mega.
sentences.reference: Karati yendaga riũa  nĩguo ikũre wega,

sentences.source: Regular monitoring of carrot fields is crucial.
sentences.translation: Gũthiĩ na mbere kũrora mĩgũnda ya karoti nĩ kwa bata mũno.
sentences.reference: Kũrora mĩgũnda ya karati kaingĩ nĩkwabata mũno.

sentences.source: Farmers scout fields to monitor pest activity.
sentences.translation: Arĩmi nĩ maroraga mĩgũnda nĩgetha maroragie ũgwati wa mĩmera.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi maroraga mĩgũnda kũrira tũtambi

sentences.source: Large-scale farms use mechanical harvesters .
sentences.translation: Mĩgũnda mĩnene nĩ ĩhũthagĩra macini cia kũgetha maciaro .
sentences.reference: Mĩgũndainĩ mĩnene ihũthagĩra macini kũgetha.

sentences.source: Disease management includes crop rotation and proper watering.
sentences.translation: Kũmenyeria mĩrimũ nĩ hamwe na kũmenyeria mĩmera na kũnyua maaĩ wega.
sentences.reference: kũgitĩra mĩrimũ kwina gũthiũrũrũkia mĩmera mũgũndainĩ na gũitĩrĩrĩa maĩ wega.

sentences.source: Farmers often thin carrot rows to improve air circulation.
sentences.translation: Arĩmi kaingĩ nĩ mathiaga na mĩtĩ mĩnini ya karoti nĩgetha rĩera rĩthiĩ na mbere gũtherema.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi nĩmamunyaga karati imwe nĩgwo gũteithia rĩera rithiũngũke wega.

sentences.source: Carrots can be eaten raw or cooked.
sentences.translation: Karoti no irĩe ĩrĩ nyũmũ kana ĩhandĩtwo.
sentences.reference: Karati no  irĩo ciĩ njĩthĩ kana irugĩtwo

sentences.source: Cabbage can tolerate light frost but not heavy frost.
sentences.translation: Gĩkũyũ no kĩhote gũkirĩrĩria ũrugarĩ mwerũ, no ti ũrugarĩ mũritũ.
sentences.reference: kabici noimere wega kũĩna heho nini no ti heho nyingĩ.

sentences.source: Farmers select seeds based on their climate.
sentences.translation: Arimi mathuuraga mbeũ kũringana na rĩera rĩao.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi macagũraga mbegu kũringana na rĩera.

sentences.source: Farmers use mechanical tools for planting and harvesting carrots.
sentences.translation: Arimi nĩ mahũthagĩra indo cia kũhanda na kũgetha karoti.
sentences.reference: Arĩmi mahũthagĩra indo cia gũthondekwo kũhanda na kũgetha karati.

sentences.source: Storage conditions affect carrot shelf life.
sentences.translation: Mĩikarĩre ya kũiga nĩ ĩhutagia mũtũũrĩre wa karoti.
