sentences.translation: Mĩtugo mĩega ya kũrĩma ndibei no ĩteithie kũrũa na mogarũrũku ma rĩera-inĩ na njĩra ya kũniina ũhũthĩri wa kaboni.
sentences.reference: Njĩra njega cia gũkũria cai no gũteithie kũgitĩra ũcenjia wa rĩera na kũnyihia kũrekererio ndogo  ya  [cs] carbon [cs]

sentences.source: Loosen the soil by tilling to a depth of about 30 cm to improve aeration and root penetration.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo ũgarũre mĩmera na ũthuthuria wa mĩri-rĩ, ũgarũre mĩmera ĩyo na ũgarũre mĩmera nginya ũriku wa cm 30.
sentences.reference: Hũra hũra tĩri  ũregere  na  ũrĩme   ũriku wa [cs] centimeter [cs]  mĩrongo ĩtatũ nĩguo tĩri ũhuthe   mĩri inyite wega

sentences.source: Use clean, sharp tools for pruning to prevent damage and reduce the risk of infection.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra indo njega cia gũtharia nĩguo ũgirĩrĩrie gũthũkwo na ũgirĩrĩrie gũkua mũrimũ.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra indo theru na njũgĩ gũceha kũgirĩrĩria gũthũkia na kũnyihia ũgwati wa mĩrimũHũthĩra indo theru na njũgĩ cia gũceha  nĩguo kũgirĩrĩria gũthũkia na kũnyihia ũgwati wa mĩrimũ

sentences.source: Space the seedbeds appropriately, leaving enough room for plant growth and management.
sentences.translation: Kũiga mĩmera ya mĩmera handũ harĩa hagĩrĩire, na ũguo ũgatũma mĩmera ĩgĩe na handũ ha gũkũra na kũmenyerera mĩmera ĩyo.
sentences.reference: Tiga mĩanya ya nathari ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire ũtigie mĩanya ya kũigana ya  mũmera gũkũra wega na kũhota kũmenyererwo

sentences.source: Harvesting intervals should be optimized to ensure high-quality tea leaves with the desired flavor profile.
sentences.translation: Mahinda ma kũgetha magĩrĩirũo gũthondekwo nĩguo magĩe na mathangũ ma ndibei ma mĩthemba mĩingĩ marĩ na mũtararĩko ũrĩa ũrenda.
sentences.reference: Mahinda   matiganĩte ma  kũgetha cai   mabatiĩ kũigananio gũtigĩrĩra macani nĩ ma gĩkĩro kĩa igũru na  cai wĩna mũcamo ũrĩa urendekana

sentences.source: Tea contains antioxidants and other compounds that offer health benefits, boosting its popularity.
sentences.translation: Thia ĩkoragwo na indo cia gũthũkia hinya wa mwĩrĩ na indo ingĩ itũmaga ĩgĩe na ũguni mũnene harĩ ũgima wa mwĩrĩ, na ũndũ ũcio ũgatũma ĩgĩe na andũ aingĩ mũno.
sentences.reference: Macani nĩ marĩ [cs] antioxidants [cs] na [cs] compounds [cs]  iria ikoragwo na ũguni harĩ  ũgima wa mwĩrĩ igatũma macani mendekane nĩ andũ

sentences.source: Conduct soil tests periodically to adjust fertilization practices.
sentences.translation: Gũthiĩ na mbere gũthuthuria ithaka kaingĩ nĩguo ũiguithanie maũndũ megiĩ gũciara mĩmera.
sentences.reference: Thima tĩri kaingĩ nĩgetha ũmenye ũrĩa  ũrĩhũthagĩra   bataraitha

sentences.source: Mimi ni ofisa wa ukulima wa ndengu
sentences.translation: Mimi ni ofisa wa ukulima wa ndengu
sentences.reference: Niĩ ndĩ obithaa wa ũrĩmi wa ndengũ

sentences.source: Tea is one of the most widely consumed beverages globally, providing both health benefits and economic value.
sentences.translation: Chaa nĩ kĩndũ kĩmwe gĩa kũnyua mũno thĩinĩ wa thĩ, na nĩ kĩheaga andũ ũgima wa mwĩrĩ na ũgima wa kĩĩmbeca.
sentences.reference: Macani nĩ mamwe ma indo iria inyuagwo mũno thĩ yothe  kũheana ũgima na kũhe arĩmi mbeca

sentences.source: Set up pheromone traps to monitor coffee berry borer populations.
sentences.translation: Rũngariai mũtego wa pheromone nĩgetha mũrũmĩrĩre mũingĩ wa andũ arĩa makoragwo na mbeũ cia cai.
sentences.reference: Gathĩka mĩtego ya [SC]pheromone[CS] nĩguo ũgirĩrĩrie ũingĩ wa [cs] coffee berry borer [cs]

sentences.source: Tea growing can be a long-term investment, with plants yielding crops for several decades.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi wa ndibei no ũkorũo ũrĩ ũtonga wa ihinda iraya, tondũ mĩmera no ĩrute irio kwa ihinda rĩa mĩaka mĩingĩ.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi wa macani nĩ ũigithia wa ihinda ĩraihu tondũ cai nĩ ũgethagũo  kahinda ka  mĩaka mĩingĩ

sentences.source: The tea industry promotes tourism in regions known for tea production, attracting visitors to tea estates.
sentences.translation: Wĩra wa kũnyua ndibei nĩ ũteithagia ũthiũrũrũko bũrũri-inĩ ũrĩa ũmenyithanĩtio na kũnyua ndibei, na nĩ ũgucagĩrĩria ageni gũceera gĩthaka-inĩ gĩa kũnyua ndibei.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi wa  macani nĩũteithagĩrĩria ũgendi  icigo inĩ iria ikũragia cai nĩ kũgucĩrĩria ageni mĩgũndainĩ ya macani

sentences.source: Test the soil pH to ensure it is slightly acidic, between 4.5 and 5.5, which is ideal for tea growth.
sentences.translation: Geria pH ya tĩĩri nĩguo ũmenye atĩ nĩ ĩrĩ acidic, gatagatĩ ka 4.5 na 5.5, ĩrĩa ĩkoragwo ĩrĩ njega mũno harĩ gũkũra ndibei.
sentences.reference: Thima [cs] pH [cs] ya tĩri nĩguo ũtigĩrĩre wĩna [cs] acidic [cs]  mũigana wa gatagatĩ ka inya gaturumo ithano nginya ithano gaturumo ithano ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire harĩ gũkũria gwa cai

sentences.source: Nursery beds should be 1 meter wide and 10-15 centimeters high.
sentences.translation: Mĩhothi ya ciana cia nda yagĩrĩirũo gũkorũo na ũraihu wa mita 1 na ũraihu wa sentimita 10-15.
sentences.reference: Nathari cia kũmerithia mbegũ ibatiĩ gũkorwo na wariĩ wa [cs] meter [cs]    imwe na ũraihu wa [cs] centimeters [cs] ikũmi nginya ikũmi na ithano

sentences.source: Regularly prune shade trees to allow sufficient light for coffee growth.
sentences.translation: Hũũra mĩtĩ ĩrĩ na kĩĩruru na hingo ciothe nĩ getha ikorũo na ũtheri mũiganu wa gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Ceha mĩtĩ ĩrĩa ĩrehaga kĩruru kaingĩ nĩgetha kahũa gakũre wega .

sentences.source: The tea industry generates foreign exchange for countries through exports.
sentences.translation: Wĩra wa kũnyua ndibei ũrehaga mbeca cia kũgarũrĩra mabũrũri kũgerera kũrutĩra mabũrũri mabũrũri mangĩ.
sentences.reference: Wendia wa macani nĩ ũrehagĩra bũrũri mbeca cia kuuma na nja

sentences.source: Maintain consistent soil moisture through regular watering, avoiding both drought and waterlogging.
sentences.translation: Rũmia ũrugarĩ wa tĩĩri kũgerera kũnyua maaĩ hingo ciothe, na gwĩthema mũiyũro wa maaĩ na mũiyũro wa maaĩ.
sentences.reference: Tigĩrĩra ũgunyu wa tĩri ni mũigananu na gũitĩrĩria maĩ kaingĩ ũgĩthemaga wagi  wa mbura na maĩ kũaraha

sentences.source: Intercropping with cover crops can reduce weed growth by shading the soil.
sentences.translation: Kũhuthĩra mĩmera mĩingĩ hamwe na mĩmera ya kũhuthĩra mĩmera no kũgirie mĩmera ĩgĩkũra na njĩra ya kũhuthĩra mĩmera kĩĩruru.
sentences.reference: Kũhandanĩria na mĩmera ĩngĩ ya kũhumbĩra tĩri nĩkũnyihagia gũkũra kwa ria na kũrehe  kĩruru

sentences.source: Prepare raised beds in the nursery to prevent waterlogging and improve drainage.
sentences.translation: Ũhaarĩrie itanda irĩ igũrũ thĩinĩ wa kanyũmba ka ciana nĩ getha gũtikagĩe na maaĩ maingĩ na ũgarũre gũthira.
sentences.reference: Harĩria natharĩ nĩguo kũgirĩrĩria maĩ kũaraha na maikũrũke

sentences.source: The demand for organic and specialty teas has increased, providing opportunities for small-scale farmers.
sentences.translation: Ciũria cia gĩthaka na cia mĩthemba mĩingĩ nĩ ciongererekete, na nĩ ũndũ ũcio kũrĩ na mĩeke ya kũhe arĩmi arĩa anini.
sentences.reference: Ũbataranu wa macani ma kĩmerera na ma mĩthemba ĩtiganĩte nĩũingĩhĩte na kuongerera mĩeke ya arĩmi anini.

sentences.source: Transplant tea seedlings when they are 6-12 months old and about 20-30 cm tall.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ya ndibei ĩgathondekwo hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ na mĩeri 6 nginya 12 na ĩrĩ na ũraihu wa cm 20 nginya 30.
sentences.reference: Handa  mĩmera ya kahũa  mĩtaroinĩ ya mwaramo wa [cs[meter [cs]  igĩrĩ gaturumo ithano nginya [cs[meter [cs]  ithatũ.

sentences.source: Rabbits reproduce quickly, so plan for future housing needs.
sentences.translation: Nyoni ciingĩragia na ihenya, na nĩ ũndũ ũcio wĩcirie ũrĩa ũngĩenda gũikara nacio mahinda mokĩte.
sentences.reference: Mbũkũ nĩ iciaranaga narua kwoguo no mũhaka ũcibangĩre nyũmba iria igaikara

sentences.source: Create contour lines on sloped land to prevent soil erosion and improve water retention.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo kũgirĩrĩria mũthanga kũgũa na kũgarũra maĩ-rĩ, kũgerera mũthanga kũgerera mũthanga kũgerera mũthanga kũgerera mũthanga, kũgerera mũthanga kũgerera mũthanga.
sentences.reference: Thondeka mĩtaro mũgũnda wĩna mũikũrũko nĩguo kũiga maĩ  na kũgirĩrĩria tĩri gũtwaro.

sentences.source: Intercrop coffee with legumes to fix nitrogen and improve soil fertility.
sentences.translation: Thondekania kahua na mĩtĩ ya mĩthabibũ nĩguo ũgarũre nitrojeni na ũgarũre ũtugi wa mĩgũnda.
sentences.reference: Handanĩrĩa kahũa na mboco  nĩguo gwĩkĩra [cs] nitrogen [cs] na kũgacĩria ũnoru wa mũgũnda

sentences.source: Water the nursery bed thoroughly before sowing the seeds to ensure adequate moisture levels.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmĩ ũtherie wega mbere ya kũhaanda mbeũ nĩguo ũkorũo na ũrugarĩ ũrĩa wagĩrĩire.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria natharĩ maĩ wega mbere ya kũhura mbegũ nĩgetha ũtigĩrĩre ũgunyu  nĩ mũiganu

sentences.source: Use shade nets or natural shading to protect young tea seedlings from excessive sunlight.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo ũgitĩre mbeũ cia ndibei kuuma ũtheri-inĩ mũingĩ wa riũa, hũthagĩra neti cia nduma kana nduma cia ndũire.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra neti cia kĩruru kana kĩruru kĩa mĩtĩ  kũgitĩra mĩcai kuumana na riũa na ũtheri mũkĩru

sentences.source: Water the seedlings immediately after transplanting to reduce transplant shock.
sentences.translation: Thondekera mĩtĩ ĩyo maaĩ o rĩmwe thutha wa gũthondekwo nĩgetha ũhootani wa gũthondekwo ũthiĩ na mbere.
sentences.reference: Wahanda o ũguo  itĩrĩria mĩmera ĩyo maĩ nĩgetha ũgirĩrĩrie kũhoha.

sentences.source: Tea cultivation can improve soil quality through organic farming practices.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi wa ndibei no wongerere mĩthemba ya mĩgũnda kũgerera ũrĩmi wa ũrĩmi wa ũrĩmi.
sentences.reference: Ũrimi wa macani nĩ wongagĩrĩra ũnoru wa tĩri nĩ ũndũ wa gũĩkĩrũo thumu

sentences.source: Sow the tea seeds in rows, spacing them 10-15 cm apart for optimal growth.
sentences.translation: Kũhaanda mbeũ cia ndibei mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtano, ũcigarũrũkie na magũrũ ma sentimita 10 nginya 15 nĩguo ikũre wega.
sentences.reference: Hura  mbegũ cia macani mĩtaroinĩ ũmĩtaganĩtie [cs] centimeter [cs] ikũmi nginya ikũmi na ithano nĩgetha ikũre wega.

sentences.source: You can use varieties such as coffee arabica, bourbon coffee, caturra and Geisha among others
sentences.translation: No ũhũthĩre mĩthemba ta cai arabica, cai wa bourbon, caturra na geisha gatagatĩ ka andũ angĩ
sentences.reference: No ũhũthĩre mĩthemba ta [cs] coffee arabica, [cs]bourbon coffee[cs], [cs] caturra na [cs] Geisha [cs]  hamwe na mĩthemba ĩrĩa  ĩngĩ

sentences.source: Apply organic manure or compost to enhance soil fertility before planting seeds.
sentences.translation: Mbere ya kũhaanda mbegũ, hũthagĩra mũtararĩko wa mĩmera kana mũtararĩko wa mĩmera nĩguo ũtũme thĩ ĩgĩe na mbeũ nyingĩ.
sentences.reference: Mbere ya kũhanda mbegũ itĩrĩria thumu kana  mahuti matukanĩire irimainĩ  nĩguo  kũgacĩria ũnoru wa tĩri

sentences.source: Ensure proper drainage systems are in place to prevent waterlogging during heavy rains.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo gwĩthema kũingĩra kwa maaĩ hĩndĩ ya mbura nene, nĩ wega gwĩthema kũingĩra kwa maaĩ na njĩra njega.
sentences.reference: Tigĩrĩra wĩna mĩtaro ya gũikũrũkia  maĩ   nĩgetha maĩ matikarahe mbura nyingĩ yaura

sentences.source: Cover the seeds lightly with soil and mulch to retain moisture and promote germination.
sentences.translation: Ĩhumbĩre mbeũ icio na mũthanga na gĩthaka nĩguo ciikare irĩ na ũrugarĩ na igĩe na ũhoti wa gũciara.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra mbegũ na tĩri na mahuti  nĩgetha ũige ũgunyu wa gũteithĩrĩria mbegũ kũmera

sentences.source: Apply fertilizers at the recommended rates, avoiding over-application that can harm plants.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra fertilizers kũringana na mũigana ũrĩa wagĩrĩire, na wĩtheme kũhũthĩra indo nyingĩ mũno iria ingĩthũkia mĩmera.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra bataraitha na ikĩro nyendekithie ũtagũĩkĩra nyingi ĩrĩa ingĩthũkia mĩmera.

sentences.source: Prepare terraces on steep slopes to create flat planting areas and reduce runoff.
sentences.translation: Ũhaarĩrie mathangũ ma kũhaarĩria mĩgũnda ya kũhaanda na kũgirĩrĩria gũtherera.
sentences.reference: Thondeka benji kũndũ gũikũrũku nĩguo ũkorwo na kũndũ kwaraganu gwa kũrima na kũnyihia kĩguũ

sentences.source: Plant during the rainy season or irrigate the field before planting to ensure soil moisture.
sentences.translation: Kũhaanda hĩndĩ ya mbura kana gũthereria mũgũnda mbere ya kũhaanda nĩguo mũthaka ũkorũo ũrĩ mũega.
sentences.reference: Handa hĩndĩ ya kĩmera kĩa  mbura kana ũitĩrĩrie maĩ mbere ya kũhanda nĩgetha ũtigĩrĩre nĩ kũgunyu.

sentences.source: Ensure proper drainage in the nursery bed to prevent waterlogging.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo gwĩthema kũiyũrwo nĩ maaĩ, gwĩthema kũiyũrwo nĩ maaĩ wega thĩinĩ wa gĩtanda kĩa ciana.
sentences.reference: Tigĩrĩra nathari nĩĩratĩrĩrio maĩ  marĩa maiganĩte nĩgetha ũgitĩre kũaraha kwa maĩ.

sentences.source: Conduct soil tests to determine nutrient levels and pH, adjusting them as necessary.
sentences.translation: Ĩka ũtuĩria wa gĩthaka nĩguo ũmenye ũigana wa irio na pH, na ũmĩcenjie kũringana na ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire.
sentences.reference: Thima tĩri nĩgetha ũmenye kana wĩna hinya mwagĩrĩru na [pH] njega nĩgetha ucigananie ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire

sentences.source: Prepare the field by plowing and leveling before transplanting coffee seedlings.
sentences.translation: Ũhaarĩrie mũgũnda ũcio na njĩra ya kũhaanda na kũiganania mbere ya kũiga mĩmera ya kahua.
sentences.reference: Harĩria mũgũnda na kũrĩma na kũiganania mbere ya kũhanda mĩmera ya kahũa werũ

sentences.source: Prune the plants to encourage bushy growth and improve air circulation.
sentences.translation: Thondekania mĩmera nĩguo ĩgĩe na mĩmera mĩega na ĩgĩe na rĩera rĩega.
sentences.reference: Ceha mĩmera nĩgetha ĩgĩe na mahuti maingĩ na kũagagĩria ũtambia wa rĩera.

sentences.source: Tea plants can be intercropped with other crops, providing farmers with additional income.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ya ndibei no ĩringithanio na mĩmera ĩngĩ, na ũndũ ũcio ũgatũma arĩmi makorũo na mbeca nyingĩ.
sentences.reference: Cai  no uhandanĩrio na mĩthemba ĩngĩ ya irio nĩguo mũrĩmi  eongerere umithio

sentences.source: Avoid feeding rabbits foods high in sugar or starch.
sentences.translation: Tiga kũhe mbũri irio irĩ na cukari kana nyũngũ nyingĩ.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme kũhe mbũkũ irio ciina cukari  na wanga mũingĩ

sentences.source: Choose healthy, disease-free seedlings or cuttings for planting in the prepared field.
sentences.translation: Thuura mĩmera mĩega na ĩtarĩ na mĩrimũ nĩguo ũhaande mũgũnda-inĩ ũrĩa ũhaarĩirio.
sentences.reference: Thura mĩmera ĩtarĩ na mĩrimu kana itihĩtio ya kũhanda mũgũndainĩ mũharĩrie

sentences.source: Water the transplanted seedlings immediately to help them establish in the new environment.
sentences.translation: Thondekera mĩmera ĩyo maaĩ o hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩguo ĩgaacĩre kũgĩa na mũtũũrĩre mwerũ.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria mĩmera ĩyo  yahandwo maĩ o rĩo nĩgetha ĩgũate hau yahandwo

sentences.source: Protect the newly transplanted seedlings from strong winds or excessive sunlight by providing shade.
sentences.translation: Kũgitĩra mbegũ iria ciĩhumbĩtwo kuuma kũrĩ rũhuho rũnene kana ũtheri mũingĩ wa riũa na njĩra ya kũheana kĩĩruru.
sentences.reference: Gitĩra mĩmera mĩeru  ĩyo yahandwo kuumana na rũhuho na riũa ikĩru na gũĩkĩra  kĩruru.

sentences.source: Regular pruning promotes new leaf production, which is crucial for high tea yields.
sentences.translation: Gũthiĩ na mbere gũtheremia mathangũ nĩ gũtũmaga magĩe na mathangũ manyu, na ũndũ ũcio nĩ wa bata mũno harĩ kũgĩa na maciaro maingĩ ma ndibei.
sentences.reference: Gũceha kaingĩ nĩgũteithagia kũruta mathangũ merũ marĩa mateithagia kũruta  maciaro maingĩ.

sentences.source: Pruning helps improve air circulation within the plant canopy, reducing the risk of disease.
sentences.translation: Gũtema nĩ gũteithagia gũthondeka rĩera thĩinĩ wa mũtaratara wa mĩmera, na ũndũ ũcio ũgatũma tũgĩe na ũgwati wa kũhiũrania na mĩrimũ.
sentences.reference: Gũceha nĩ gũteithagia rĩera gũtamba wega igũrũ wa mĩmera na kũnyihia ũgwati wa mĩrimũ

sentences.source: Handpick larger pests like caterpillars to reduce infestation.
sentences.translation: Hũthagĩra ũhoti wa gũthuura mĩrimũ mĩnene ta njũng'wa kũgirĩrĩria mĩrimũ ĩyo.
sentences.reference: Ruta tũtambĩ tũnene ta ĩgunyu na moko nĩgetha ũnyihie mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Picked flowers should be put into well-ventilated baskets to reduce fermentation.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa yaguũragwo yagĩrĩirũo kũigĩrũo ithandũkũ-inĩ iria irĩ na ũrugarĩ mwega nĩ getha ĩthiĩ na mbere gũtherema.
sentences.reference: Mahũa marĩa matuĩtwo mabatiĩ kũigwo ikabu-inĩ  ikũrehe  rĩera wega nĩgetha kũnyihia kũgagata.

sentences.source: Mulch around the base of the plants to retain moisture and suppress weed growth.
sentences.translation: Gũthondekera mĩmera mũthingi-inĩ nĩ ũndũ wa gũtũũria ũrugarĩ na kũgirĩrĩria mĩmera ĩgĩkũra.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra gĩtinainĩ  kĩa mũmera nĩguo ũige ũgunyu na  ũhite kũmera kwa ria.

sentences.source: Fill the hole with soil, gently firming it around the roots to remove air pockets.
sentences.translation: Mũiyũre kĩhũngĩro kĩu na mũthanga, na ũgĩthingatage na njĩra hũthũ mĩri-inĩ nĩguo ũkirie mĩhuko ya rĩera.
sentences.reference: Iyũria irima na tĩri na ũkindĩre kahora mĩriinĩ  nĩgetha weherie tũmĩanya twa rĩera.

sentences.source: Consider supplementing their diet with mineral blocks.
sentences.translation: Ta wĩcirie ũhoro wa kũingĩria irio icio indo-inĩ iria irĩ thĩinĩ wa irio ciao.
sentences.reference: Wĩcirie kũongerera [cs] mineral blocks [cs[ irio-inĩ

sentences.source: Inspect stored coffee beans periodically for signs of pests or mold.
sentences.translation: Gũthiĩ na mbere gũthuthuria mbegũ cia kahua iria ciigagwo tene na tene nĩguo wone kana nĩ kũrĩ ũgwati wa mĩrimũ kana mũrimũ.
sentences.reference: Thũrima mbegũ cia kahũa iria cigĩtwo thitoo   mahinda kwa mahinda nĩgetha wone kana harĩ na tũtambi kana mbaa.

sentences.source: Replace any weak or damaged plants with new seedlings to ensure uniform growth.
sentences.translation: Kũgarũra mĩmera ĩrĩa mĩũru kana mĩũru na mĩmera mĩerũ nĩguo kũgĩe na ũrũmwe wa gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Kũrania mĩmera  ĩrĩa mĩhohu na mĩtihie na mĩmera mĩeru nĩguo gũtigĩrĩra nĩrakũra ĩiganaine.

sentences.source: Water the nursery bed regularly to keep the soil moist.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra maaĩ ma gũtheremia mũgũnda nĩgetha ũthiĩ na mbere gũtheremia.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria natharĩ maĩ kahinda gwa kahinda nĩgetha ũige  tĩri wĩna ũgunyu mũiganu.

sentences.source: Transplant seedlings to the field when they have 4-6 true leaves.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩgathondekwo mũgũnda-inĩ hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ na mathangũ 4-6 ma maguoya.
sentences.reference: Handa mĩmera mũgũnda-inĩ yagĩa mathangũ makĩru mana nginya matandatũ.

sentences.source: Gently remove the seedlings from the nursery, taking care not to damage the roots.
sentences.translation: Ĩra mĩmera ĩyo na ũhoreri kuuma nyũmba-inĩ ya ciana, na wĩmenyerere ndũkae gũthũkia mĩri.
sentences.reference: Kũra mĩmera kuuma natharĩ-inĩ na ũmenyerere ndũgathũkie mĩri.

sentences.source: Place the seedling in the hole, ensuring the root collar is level with the soil surface.
sentences.translation: Gatua mbeũ ĩyo kĩhingo-inĩ, na ũmenye atĩ kĩhingo kĩa mũri nĩ kĩiganĩte na mũthanga.
sentences.reference: Handa mũmera irima-inĩ na ũtigĩrĩre mĩri nĩ ihumbĩrĩtwo nĩ tĩri.

sentences.source: Choose a cloudy or rainy day for transplanting to minimize stress on the seedlings.
sentences.translation: Thuura mũthenya ũrĩ na matu kana mbura nĩguo ũherie mĩmera.
sentences.reference: Thuura  mũthenya wĩna matu kana mbura wa kũhanda mĩmera  nĩguo ĩgwate wega.

sentences.source: Apply organic manure or compost to each hole before transplanting the seedlings.
sentences.translation: Mbere ya kũiga mĩmera-inĩ ĩyo, hũthagĩra mũtararĩko wa mĩmera kana mũtararĩko wa mĩmera-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra irima o irima thumu kana  mahuti matukanĩirio irima-inĩ ũtanahanda mĩmera.

sentences.source: Add compost or organic manure to the planting hole before transplanting.
sentences.translation: Kwaria mũtaratara-inĩ wa kũhaanda mbere ya kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara wa kũhaanda mũtaratara.
sentences.reference: Ongerera  mahuti mahumbĩrĩtwo kana thumu irima-inĩ ũtanahanda mũmera.

sentences.source: Use nitrogen-based fertilizers to promote leafy growth in tea plants.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra manemane marĩa makoragwo na nitrojeni gũtwarithia mĩtĩ ya ndibei na mbere gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Hũthira bataraitha ĩna [cs] nitrogen [cs]   nĩ getha  ĩkũrie mathangũ maingĩ mĩmera-inĩ ya macani

sentences.source: Prepare the main field by tilling and leveling the soil, ensuring proper drainage.
sentences.translation: Ũhaarĩrie mũgũnda ũrĩa mũnene na njĩra ya kũhaanda na kũiganania mũgũnda, na njĩra ya kũmenyeria atĩ mũgũnda ũcio nĩ ũrathiĩ wega.
sentences.reference: Harĩria mũgũnda na kũrĩma na kũiganania tĩri na kũenja mĩtaro

sentences.source: Prune tea plants annually to maintain their shape and encourage bushy growth.
sentences.translation: Gũthondeka mĩmera ya ndibei o mwaka nĩguo ĩgĩe na mũtaratara mwega wa gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Ceha macani o mwaka nĩguo maige mũhanĩre wamo na magacĩrithie kũmera mathangũ

sentences.source: Regularly prune coffee plants to maintain proper shape and remove dead branches.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra mahinda mothe gũthondeka mĩtĩ ya kahua nĩguo ĩgĩe na mũtaratara ũrĩa wagĩrĩire na ĩherie honge cia kahua iria ciakuĩte.
sentences.reference: Ceha kahũa o hingo nĩguo ĩikare na mũhanĩre mwega na weherie honge nyũmũ

sentences.source: Soil type and drainage strongly affect a sites suitability for pyrethrum growing
sentences.translation: Mũthemba wa gĩthaka na gũthira wa gĩthaka nĩ ũhutagia mũno ũigananĩru wa gĩthaka harĩ mĩmera ya pyrethrum
sentences.reference: Mũthemba wa tĩri na ũhoti wa tĩri kũnywa maĩ nĩundu ũngĩ ũroragwo ũkũriainĩ wa Mahũa ma mbeniko

sentences.source: Keep track of market trends to adjust your rabbit meat prices accordingly.
sentences.translation: Rora ũrĩa thoko ĩrathiĩ na mbere nĩguo ũiguithanie thogora wa nyama ya mbũri.
sentences.reference: Ikara ũkimenyaga ũrĩa thoko ĩikarĩte nĩgetha ũcenjĩe thogora wa kũendia nyama cia mbũkũ ũria kwagĩrĩire

sentences.source: After pruning, apply fertilizers to support the regrowth of leaves and branches.
sentences.translation: Thutha wa gũthondeka, hũthagĩra maguta nĩguo magĩe na mathangũ na mathangũ ma gũkũra rĩngĩ.
sentences.reference: Thutha wa gũceha, ĩkĩra thumu nĩguo mathangũ na honge ikũre rĩngĩ

sentences.source: Regular plucking of tea leaves encourages new growth and prevents the plants from becoming overgrown.
sentences.translation: Kũgũtha mathangũ ma ndibei kaingĩ nĩ gũtũmaga mĩmera ĩthiĩ na mbere gũkũra na kũgirĩrĩria mĩmera ĩthiĩ na mbere gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Gũtua macani mahinda kwa mahinda nĩ gũtigagĩrĩra nimakũra rĩngĩ na mĩmera ndĩra neneha mũno

sentences.source: Protect coffee plants from strong winds by planting windbreaks around the farm.
sentences.translation: Kũgitĩra mĩmera ya kahua kuuma rũhuho-inĩ rũnene na njĩra ya kũiga mĩmera ya kũgarũra rũhuho mĩgũnda-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Gitagĩrĩra  mĩmera ya kahũa kuma rũhuho rũingĩ na kũhanda mĩti ya kũnyihia rũhuho gũthiũrũrũkĩria mũgũnda

sentences.source: Irrigate coffee plants during dry spells to maintain consistent growth.
sentences.translation: Thondekera mĩtĩ ya kahua maaĩ hĩndĩ ya ũrugarĩ nĩguo ĩthiĩ na mbere gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Taatagĩria kahũa maĩ kĩmera kĩa riũa nĩgetha ĩkũre hĩndĩ ciothe

sentences.source: Apply organic fertilizer in the nursery bed for healthy seedling growth.
sentences.translation: Gũthondekera mĩmera mĩruru mũtarũ-inĩ wa ciana nĩgetha mĩmera ĩgĩe na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra thumu ikũrĩrio nĩguo mĩmera ĩkũre wega

sentences.source: Apply fertilizers after soil tests to address specific nutrient deficiencies.
sentences.translation: Thutha wa gũthuthuria gĩthaka, hũthagĩra marũũri nĩguo ũhote kũhiũrania na kwaga irio.
sentences.reference: Ĩkĩra thumu thutha wa gũthima tĩri nigetha kumenyeke [cs]nutrient[cs] ĩria ĩraga

sentences.source: Promote the nutritional benefits of rabbit meat to attract health-conscious consumers.
sentences.translation: Kũnyita mbaru ũguni wa irio wa nyama cia mbũri nĩgetha andũ makorũo na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ.
sentences.reference: Tambia ndũmĩrĩri cia  ũguni  wa kũrĩa  nyama ya mbũkũ  nĩgetha ũgucĩrĩrie agũri arĩa mamenyagĩrĩra ũgima wao wa mwĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Prune during the dormant season to minimize stress on the plants.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo mĩmera ĩgĩe na mathĩna maingĩ-rĩ, ĩraage mĩmera ĩyo hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ mĩmera.
sentences.reference: Ceha rĩrĩa gũtarĩ na ũrĩmi mũingĩ  nĩgetha  kũnyihia  kũhinyĩrĩrĩka kwa mĩmera.

sentences.source: Continue to weed the field regularly to reduce competition for nutrients and water.
sentences.translation: Thiĩ na mbere kũhaanda mĩgũnda ĩyo kaingĩ nĩguo ũikare ũtarĩ na indo cia kũrĩa na maaĩ.
sentences.reference: Thiĩ na mbere na kũrĩmĩra  ria nĩgetha ũnyihie mũhĩtahĩtano wa  irio na maĩ harĩ  mĩmera.

sentences.source: Practice contour planting on slopes to prevent soil erosion in coffee fields.
sentences.translation: Wĩmenyerere kũhaanda mĩgũnda-inĩ ya kahua nĩguo ũgirĩrĩrie mĩgũnda ya kahua ĩgĩe na gĩthaka.
sentences.reference: Menyera kũhanda benji mĩikũrũko-inĩ nĩgetha  kũgirĩrĩa tĩri gũtuĩka mĩgũnda-inĩ ya kahũa.

sentences.source: Dig planting holes 60 centimeters deep and wide for each coffee plant.
sentences.translation: Kũhũra ihingũ cia kũhanda kahua na ũraihu wa sentimita 60 harĩ mũtĩ o ũmwe wa kahua.
sentences.reference: Enja marima marĩ na ũriku  na wariĩ wa [cs] centimeters [cs] mĩrongo ĩtandatũ harĩ o mũmera wa kahũa.

sentences.source: Sow coffee seeds 1-2 centimeters deep in the nursery bed.
sentences.translation: Kũhaanda mbeũ cia kahua na ũritũ wa sentimita 1-2 thĩinĩ wa gĩtanda kĩa ciana.
sentences.reference: Hura mbegũ cia kahũa na ũriku-inĩ  wa [cs] centimeters [cs] ĩmwe nginya igĩrĩ natharĩ-inĩ.

sentences.source: Maintain proper spacing between coffee plants to reduce pest outbreaks.
sentences.translation: Gĩaga na handũ hega gatagatĩ-inĩ ga mĩmera ya kahua nĩ getha ũgwati wa mĩrimũ ũniinwo.
sentences.reference: Tigithũkania mĩmera ya kahũa wega nĩguo kũnyihia mũtuthũko wa tũtambi

sentences.source: Avoid harvesting immature or overripe coffee cherries to maintain uniformity.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo ũtigane na ũrũmwe-rĩ, wĩtheme kũgetha nyeki iria itanyihĩte kana iria itanyihĩte mũno.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme kũgetha mbũni ĩtarĩ ngũrũ kana  iria ciĩruite mũno nĩgetha ũkorwo na ũigananu wa  o igetha.

sentences.source: Apply neem oil to control coffee berry borer infestation.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra maguta ma neem kũrũgamĩrĩra mũrimũ ũcio.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria maguta ma  [cs] neem [cs] nĩgetha  ũgirĩrĩe kahũa kũgũmĩrwo nĩ gathegethi  ka mbũni  ya kahũa.

sentences.source: Prepare the coffee nursery bed in a shaded area with well-drained soil.
sentences.translation: Ũhaarĩrie gĩtanda kĩa kahua gĩikare handũ harĩa kũrĩ na kĩĩruru na harĩa kũrĩ mũthanga mwega.
sentences.reference: Harĩrĩa natharĩ ya kahũa handũ harĩ na kĩruru na tĩri wĩna ũikũrũkia  mwega wa maĩ.

sentences.source: Always ensure your rabbit meat complies with local food safety regulations.
sentences.translation: Hũũra ũmenye atĩ nyama ya mbũri nĩ ĩrũmagĩrĩra mawatho ma bũrũri waku megiĩ ũgitĩri wa irio.
sentences.reference: Hĩndĩ ciothe tigĩrĩra nyama yaku ya mbũkũ  nĩkinyĩtie gĩkĩro kĩa wega wa irio kĩrĩa gĩkĩrĩtwo nĩ watho.

sentences.source: Sort and grade coffee cherries immediately after harvesting.
sentences.translation: Kũmenyeria na kũmenyeria gĩthaka kĩa kahua o rĩmwe thutha wa kũgetha.
sentences.reference: Thura na ũgayanie  mbuni  o warĩkia kũgetha.

sentences.source: Mulch around coffee plants to conserve soil moisture and suppress weeds.
sentences.translation: Ĩrutanĩrie mĩtĩ-inĩ ya kahua nĩ getha ũtũme thĩ ĩgĩe na ũrugarĩ na ũgirĩrĩrie mĩmera mĩũru.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra itina cia kahũa na mahuti nĩgetha kũiga ũgunyu wa tĩri na kũgirĩrĩria ria.

sentences.source: Inspect coffee plants regularly for signs of pest damage.
sentences.translation: Gũthuthuria mĩmera ya kahua kaingĩ nĩguo wone kana nĩ ĩrĩ na ũgwati wa mĩmera ĩyo.
sentences.reference: Barania  mĩmera ya kahũa kaingi  ũrore  marũri ma ũthũkangia wa tũtambĩ.

sentences.source: Use drip irrigation to conserve water and deliver nutrients efficiently.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra ũrigithathi kũiga maaĩ na kũruta irio na njĩra njega.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra njĩra ya gũtatia maĩ nĩgetha kũnyihia ũhũthĩri mũingĩ wa maĩ na gũkinyia hinya na njĩra njega.

sentences.source: Provide clean bedding in the rabbit house, such as straw or wood shavings.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra indo njega cia gũkoma nyũmba-inĩ ĩyo, ta gĩthaka kana gĩthaka kĩa mbaũ.
sentences.reference: Harĩria handũ hatheru ha gũkoma nyũmba-inĩ ya mbũkũ  ũkĩhũthĩra  rũũa  rwa mwere , rũũa  rwa ngano kana mura.

sentences.source: Avoid over-irrigation to prevent fungal infections in coffee plants.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo gwĩthema mĩrimũ ya ng'ombe mĩtĩ-inĩ ya kahua, gwĩthema kũnyua mũno.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme gũitĩrĩria maĩ maingĩ  mũno nĩgetha kũgirĩrĩria mĩmera ya kahaũa kũgũmĩrwo nĩ mĩrimũ ya [cs] fungal [cs].

sentences.source: Remove suckers and water shoots to maintain a single stem in coffee plants.
sentences.translation: Rekereria magũrũ na magũrũ ma maaĩ magĩe na gĩthima kĩmwe thĩinĩ wa mĩmera ya kahua.
sentences.reference: Eheria tũthuna na tũthethũka nĩgetha  ngoro ya mĩtĩ ya kahũa ĩkorwo ĩrĩ o ĩmwe.

sentences.source: Introduce natural predators like ants to control coffee pests biologically.
sentences.translation: Kũheana nyamũ cia ũgwati cia ndũire ta nyeki nĩgetha ikorũo irĩ na ũhoti wa kũgirĩrĩria mĩmera ya kahua.
sentences.reference: No ũrehe  tũtambi tũria tũriaga tũnyamũ  tũnini ta thuraku twa kũgirĩrĩria mĩrimũ [cs] biologically [cs]

sentences.source: Apply organic or chemical fertilizers twice a year for optimal coffee growth.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra mĩthiithũ ya mĩthiithũ kana ya kemia maita merĩ thĩinĩ wa mwaka nĩguo kahua gakure wega.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria bataraitha cia kĩmerera na cia [cs] chemical [cs]  maita merĩ mwaka nĩguo kahũa gakũre wega.

sentences.source: Grade coffee beans based on size, weight, and quality.
sentences.translation: Gũthondekithia mbegũ cia kahua kũringana na ũnene, ũritũ, na ũritũ.
sentences.reference: Thuraia  mbegũ cia kahũa kumana na ũigana, ũritũ na wagĩrĩru.

sentences.source: Dry coffee beans on raised beds or patios to reduce moisture content.
sentences.translation: Mbegũ cia kahua iria ciumaga itambũrũkĩtio na igũrũ kana itambũrũkĩtio nĩgetha ikorũo irĩ na ũrugarĩ mũingĩ.
sentences.reference: Ũmithia mbuni cia kahũa kĩrĩrĩ-inĩ kana handũ haraganu  nĩgetha kũnyihia gĩkĩro kĩa ũgunyu

sentences.source: Mulch with coffee husks to recycle nutrients back into the soil.
sentences.translation: Gũthondekwo na makũmbĩ ma kahua nĩgetha magĩe na irio cia gũthondekwo thĩinĩ wa tĩĩri.
sentences.reference: Humbĩra na makoni  ma kahũa nĩgetha ũcokie irio cia ũkũria tĩri-inĩ.

sentences.source: Irrigate coffee plants during dry spells to maintain consistent growth.
sentences.translation: Thondekera mĩtĩ ya kahua maaĩ hĩndĩ ya ũrugarĩ nĩguo ĩthiĩ na mbere gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Itĩrĩria mĩmera ya kahũa maĩ hĩndĩ ya riũa  nĩgetha ĩkure wega

sentences.source: Control pests by maintaining cleanliness and using natural repellents.
sentences.translation: Kũgirĩrĩria mĩrimũ na njĩra ya gũtũũria ũtheru na kũhũthĩra ndawa cia kũhũũrana cia ndũire.
sentences.reference: Girĩgĩrĩria  tũtambĩ  na njĩra  ya  kũiga ũtheru na gũtũmĩra indo cia kĩmerera cia gũtũingata.

sentences.source: Store dried coffee beans in moisture-proof bags to prevent spoilage.
sentences.translation: Tigaga mbegũ cia kahua iria ciũrĩte mĩgathĩ-inĩ ĩtarĩ na ũrugarĩ nĩguo itigathũkio.
sentences.reference: Iga mbũni ĩrĩkĩtie kũniara mĩhukoinĩ ĩtangĩingĩria ũgunyu kũgirĩrĩria  ndĩgathũke

sentences.source: Rabbit farming starts with constructing a proper house for your rabbits.
sentences.translation: Ũrĩmi wa mbũri wambĩrĩirie na gwaka mũciĩ mwega wa mbũri ciaku.
sentences.reference: Ũrĩmi wa mbũkũ wambagĩrĩria na gũciakĩra nyũmba njega.

sentences.source: Avoid excessive nitrogen application, which can increase pest and disease susceptibility.
sentences.translation: Wĩtigĩre kũhũthĩra nitrojeni mũno, na ũndũ ũcio no wongerere ũgwati wa mĩrimũ na mĩrimũ.
sentences.reference: Wĩtheme gwĩkĩra [cs] nitrogen [cs] makĩria tondũ noyongerere ũhũthũ wa kũgũmĩrwo nĩ tũtambi na mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: Feed rabbits a balanced diet to ensure healthy growth.
sentences.translation: Kũhe mbũri irio njega nĩguo ikũre wega.
sentences.reference: He mbũkũ irio  ginyanĩrĩrũ nĩgetha ikũre wega.

sentences.source: Handpick ripe coffee cherries during the harvest season.
sentences.translation: Thuura ngũyũ cia cai iria ciakĩrire na guoko hĩndĩ ya magetha.
sentences.reference: Tua na moko mbũni  njĩru  hĩndĩ ya kũgetha.

sentences.source: Common pests in rabbit farming include mites, fleas, and ticks.
sentences.translation: Mĩrimũ ĩrĩa ĩingĩragwo mũno harĩ kũrĩma njũkĩ nĩ ta njũng'wa, njũng'wa, na njũng'wa.
sentences.reference: Tũtambi tũrĩa tũgũmagĩra ũrĩmi wa mbũku nĩ hamwe na  mũthũa, thuya na ngũha.

sentences.source: Winter wheat is planted in the fall and can survive freezing temperatures.
sentences.translation: Mĩgũnda ya ngano ya hĩndĩ ya heho ĩhaandaga hĩndĩ ya ũrugarĩ na no ĩhote kũhiũrania na ũrugarĩ mũnene.
sentences.reference: Ngano ya hĩndĩ ya heho ĩhandagwo heho yanyihanyiha  na noyage gũtorio  nĩ heho ĩna mbarafu.

sentences.source: Ensure the meat remains at a safe temperature during transport.
sentences.translation: Nĩgetha nyama ĩyo ĩtũũre ĩrĩ na ũrugarĩ mũkinyanĩru hĩndĩ ya gũthiĩ.
sentences.reference: Tĩgĩrĩra nyama nĩyaigwo na ũrugarĩ ũrĩa wagĩrĩire  igĩtwarwo thoko.

sentences.source: Plant shade trees in the coffee field to protect plants from direct sunlight.
sentences.translation: Metha mĩtĩ ya kĩĩruru mũgũnda-inĩ wa cai nĩguo ũgitĩre mĩmera kuuma riũa-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Handa mĩtĩ ya  kũrehe kĩruru mũgũndainĩ wa kahũa kũgirĩrĩria riũa ihiũ.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum thrives in well-drained, loamy volcanic soils with a pH of >5.6.
sentences.translation: Mĩtĩ ya Pyrethrum ĩkoragwo ĩrĩ mĩruru wega na ĩrĩ mĩruru mũno na ĩrĩ na pH ya > 5.6.
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko makũraga wega tĩri-inĩ  ũikũrũkagia maĩ wega ũri na [cs] pH [cs]  ĩtagũkĩra ithano turuma ithathatũ.

sentences.source: Monitor market prices to determine the best time to sell coffee.
sentences.translation: Rora thogora wa thoko nĩguo ũmenye ihinda rĩrĩa rĩega rĩa kwendia cai.
sentences.reference: Thũgũnda mathogora nĩgetha ũmenye hĩndĩ ĩrĩa njega ya kwendia kahũa.

sentences.source: Maintain a soil pH between 5.5 and 6.5 for optimal coffee growth.
sentences.translation: Gũtũũria pH ya mũthanga gatagatĩ ka 5.5 na 6.5 nĩguo kahua gakure wega.
sentences.reference: Iga  gĩthimi gĩa tĩri kĩrĩ kĩa [cs] pH [cs] gatagatĩinĩ  ka ithano na nuthu nginya ithathatũ na nuthu nĩgetha kahũa gakũre wega

sentences.source: Monitor soil pH and adjust with lime or sulfur as needed.
sentences.translation: Rora pH ya tĩĩri na ũthondeke na gĩthaka kana gĩthaka ta ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire.
sentences.reference: Rora ithimi  cia [cs] pH [cs] ya tĩri na ũigananie na  [sc] lime [cs] kana [cs] sulfur [cs]   ũria kũbataire.

sentences.source: Include pellets in their diet for essential nutrients.
sentences.translation: Ciĩga icio nĩ cia bata mũno harĩ andũ.
sentences.reference: Ongerera tũirio twa mbũkũ irio-inĩ nĩguo kũongerera hinya mwĩrĩ.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum is a perennial crop -takes a period longer than two years without the need of being replanted each year
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum nĩ mĩmera ya tene na tene - ĩkoragwo na ihinda rĩa makĩria ma mĩaka ĩĩrĩ ĩtarĩ na bata wa kũhaanda rĩngĩ o mwaka
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko  nĩ mũmera  wa gũtũra  ũrĩa woyaga  kahinda ka makĩria ma mĩaka ĩrĩ  ũtakubatara kũhandwo rĩngĩ   mwaka o mwaka.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum requires a temperature of less than 18° C for at least 6 weeks
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum nĩ ĩbataraga ũrugarĩ wa thĩiniĩ wa 18°C kwa ihinda rĩa ciumia ithathatũ
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko mabataraga mũigana wa ũrugarĩ  ũtakĩrĩtie [cs[ centigrade [cs] ikũmi na inyanya  gwa kahinda ka ciumia ithathatũ.

sentences.source: Separate sections for breeding and growing rabbits in the house.
sentences.translation: Mĩcemanio ya gũciara na ya kũrera mbũri nyũmba-inĩ.
sentences.reference: Gayania icunjĩ cia gũciarĩra  na  gũkũrĩra nyũmbainĩ ya mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Ensure compliance with coffee farming regulations and standards for quality assurance.
sentences.translation: Kũmenyeria kũhingia mawatho ma ũrĩmi wa kahua na ithimi cia ũigananĩrie wa ũigananĩru.
sentences.reference: Tĩgĩrĩra nĩ wahingia mawatho na mĩtaratara  ya ũrĩmi wa kahũa na ikĩro iria  ciandĩkithĩtio.

sentences.source: Fresh vegetables and leafy greens are good for rabbits.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera mĩerũ na mathangũ ma mathangũ nĩ mega harĩ njũkĩ.
sentences.reference: Mboga cia mũũkano na nyeni nĩ irio njega cia kũhe mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Keep a breeding schedule to maintain a steady supply of rabbits.
sentences.translation: Rũmia mũtaratara wa gũciara nĩguo ũikare ũrĩ na mbũri nyingĩ.
sentences.reference: Iga mũtaratara wa gũciarana kwa mbũkũ nĩgetha ũkoragwo na mbũkũ cia kwendia hĩndĩ ciothe.

sentences.source: Always check for signs of pests in the rabbit house.
sentences.translation: Hingo ciothe wĩthuthurie ũmenye atĩ nĩ kũrĩ mĩrimũ thĩinĩ wa kanyũmba ka njũkĩ.
sentences.reference: Hingo ciothe rora kana  nyũmba ya mbũkũ ĩna tũnyamũ tũangangi.

sentences.source: Too much rain during harvest can cause wheat grains to sprout prematurely.
sentences.translation: Kũgĩa na mbura nyingĩ mũno hĩndĩ ya magetha no gũtũme mbeũ cia ngano ciume mbere ya ihinda.
sentences.reference: Mbura nyingĩ  hĩndĩ ya kũgetha  no ĩtũme ngano ĩthethũke ihinda rĩtakinyĩte.

sentences.source: Use wire mesh and wood to build a durable rabbit house.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra waya na mbaũ gwaka nyũmba ya nyoni ya gũtũũra.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra [cs] wire mesh[cs]  na mbaũ gũaka nyũmba  ĩngitũra ya gũikarwo nĩ mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Properly chill the meat immediately after slaughtering to preserve freshness.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo nyama ĩikare irĩ njerũ-rĩ, ĩhũũre wega ica ikuhĩ thutha wa gũthĩnjwo.
sentences.reference: Hehia nyama wega  warĩkia gũthĩnja  nĩguo  ũige nyama ĩyo ĩtagũthũka.

sentences.source: Thoroughly wash the rabbit carcass to remove any contaminants.
sentences.translation: Gũthambia mwĩrĩ wa mbũri wega nĩgetha ũtherie indo ciothe iria ciũragwo.
sentences.reference: Thambia  mũrũndũrũndũ wa mbũkũ wega  nĩgetha ũrute gĩko gĩothe.

sentences.source: Bleed the rabbit properly after slaughtering for better meat quality.
sentences.translation: Thakame thuku wega thutha wa gũthĩnjwo nĩgetha nyama ĩkorũo ĩrĩ njega makĩria.
sentences.reference: Ita thakame ya mbũku wega thutha wa gũthĩnja nĩguo ĩkorwo na nyama ya gĩkĩro kĩa igũrũ.

sentences.source: It has been a vital crop for human consumption for over 10,000 years.
sentences.translation: Kwa ihinda rĩa mĩaka makĩria ma 10,000, mbeũ ĩyo nĩ ya bata mũno harĩ andũ.
sentences.reference: Ĩkoretwo irĩ ĩrio cia bata cia kũrĩo nĩ andũ gwa kahinda ka miaka ngiri ikũmi.

sentences.source: It is used to make bread, pasta, and various baked goods.
sentences.translation: Nĩ ĩhũthagĩrũo kũruga mĩgate, pasta, na indo ingĩ cia kũruga.
sentences.reference: ĩhũthagirwo kuruga mĩgate, [cs] pasta [cs] na irio ingĩ cia kũruga mĩgate.

sentences.source: Obtain necessary permits and licenses for selling rabbit meat.
sentences.translation: Kũgĩa na marũa ma gwĩtĩkĩrĩrio na marũa ma gwĩtĩkĩrĩrio kwendia nyama cia mbũri.
sentences.reference: Etha marũa na ritheni ma gũgũitĩkĩria kwendia nyama cia mbũkũ

sentences.source: Use humane trapping methods if you need to remove pests from the rabbit house.
sentences.translation: Angĩkorũo nĩ ũrabatara kũruta tũng'aurũ nyũmba-inĩ ĩyo, hũthagĩra njĩra cia kũnyiita tũng'aurũ na njĩra ya ũmenyeru.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra mĩtego ĩtari mĩrũrũ ya kweheria tũtambi nyũmbainĩ ya mbũkũ

sentences.source: Introduce new foods gradually to prevent digestive issues.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo wĩtheme kũgĩa na mathĩna ma digestive, thomaga irio njerũ o kahora.
sentences.reference: Ambĩrĩria kũhe mbũkũ irio ngeni kahora itikarũare nda

sentences.source: Use a sharp knife for quick and effective slaughter.
sentences.translation: Hũthĩra rũhiũ rwa njora kũniina andũ na ihenya.
sentences.reference: Hũthĩra kahiũ kogĩ gũthĩnja narua na njĩra njega

sentences.source: Start small with your rabbit farming and expand as you gain experience.
sentences.translation: Ambĩrĩria ũrĩmi-inĩ waku wa mbũri ũrĩ mũnini na ũthiĩ na mbere na ũrĩmi ũcio o ũrĩa ũgĩaga na ũmenyeru.
sentences.reference: Ambĩrĩria kahora ũrĩmi wa mbũkũ na waramie ũrĩmi wongerera ũgĩ

sentences.source: Attend farmers' markets to sell directly to consumers.
sentences.translation: Gũthiĩ ithandũkũ-inĩ cia arĩmi nĩguo mahũthĩre indo ciao kũrehera andũ.
sentences.reference: Ceraga thoko cia arĩmĩ nigetha wenderie agũri gũtari mĩhĩnga

sentences.source: Compost is often applied before wheat planting to improve soil fertility.
sentences.translation: Makĩria ma ũguo, mbere ya kũhaanda ngano, no kũhũthĩrũo mbegũ nĩguo thĩ ĩgĩe na maciaro maingĩ.
sentences.reference: Thumu wa [cs] compost [cs] wĩkĩragwo ngano ĩkĩhandwo nĩgetha wongerere ũnoru wa tĩri.

sentences.source: Wheat is often grown in regions with moderate to low rainfall.
sentences.translation: Kaingĩ ngano ĩreagwo kũndũ kũrĩa gũkoragwo na mbura nene kana nene.
sentences.reference: Ngano ĩkũragio kũndũ kwĩ mbura njiganu nginya nini.

sentences.source: Proper sanitation reduces the risk of disease outbreaks.
sentences.translation: Kũmenyeria andũ wega nĩ kũrehaga mogwati ma kũhiũrania na mĩrimũ.
sentences.reference: Ũtheru ũrĩa wagĩrĩire  nĩũnyihagia ũgwati wa gũtuthũka kwa mĩrimũ

sentences.source: It is part of the Brassica family, like broccoli and kale.
sentences.translation: Nĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩa mũhĩrĩga wa Brassica, o ta broccoli na kale.
sentences.reference: Nĩ ya bamĩrĩ ya [cs] Brassica [cs]   ta [cs] broccoli [cs] na [cs] kale [cs].

sentences.source: Adequate rainfall at the flowering stage is crucial for grain development.
sentences.translation: Kũgĩa na mbura nyingĩ hĩndĩ ya kũruga nĩ kwa bata mũno harĩ gũkũria mbeũ.
sentences.reference: Mbura njiganu mahũa  makĩruta kiro nĩ ya bata nĩgetha mbegũ ikũre wega.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum is a perennial crop with a lifespan of up to 4 years.
sentences.translation: Pyrethrum nĩ mĩmera ya tene na tene ĩrĩa ĩkoragwo na muoyo wa mĩaka ĩna.
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko nĩ mũmera wa gũikara mĩaka mĩingĩ mũgũnda na maikaraga kahinda ka mĩaka ĩna.

sentences.source: Regularly check the rabbit house for signs of wear and tear.
sentences.translation: Rekei tũthuthurie nyũmba-inĩ ya nyoni kaingĩ nĩguo tũthuthurie kana nĩ kũrĩ maũndũ marĩa maronania atĩ nyoni ĩyo nĩ ĩhumbĩte.
sentences.reference: Roraga kaingĩ kĩonania gĩa gũthũka  kwa nyũmba ya mbũkũ.

sentences.source: Plough and apply herbicides about 2 weeks before planting.
sentences.translation: Kũgũa na kũhũthĩra ndawa cia kũniina mĩmera ta ciumia igĩrĩ mbere ya kũhaanda.
sentences.reference: Rĩma na ũhuhĩre ndawa ciumia ta  igirĩ ũtanahanda

sentences.source: Proper hygiene is essential during the slaughtering process.
sentences.translation: Nĩ harĩ bata gũkorũo na ũtheru ũrĩa wagĩrĩire hĩndĩ ya gũthĩnjwo.
sentences.reference: Ũtheru mwega nĩ wa bata mũno hĩndĩ  ya gũthĩnja.

sentences.source: Consistent moisture from rainfall or irrigation is important for cabbage.
sentences.translation: Kũgĩa na ũrugarĩ mũkinyanĩru kuuma kũrĩ mbura kana ũrigithathi nĩ kwa bata mũno harĩ ndigithũ.
sentences.reference: Ũgunyu ũrehetwo nĩ  mbura kana uunĩthĩria wa maĩ  nĩ ũrĩ bata ũkūria-inĩ wa   kabici.

sentences.source: Accurate fertilizer application rates are dependent on results from the soil analysis.
sentences.translation: Mĩigana ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire ya kũhũthĩrũo kwa mĩmera nĩ ĩrĩkoragwo ĩrũmĩrĩire moimĩrĩro ma ũthuthuria wa ithaka.
sentences.reference: Gĩkĩro kĩringanu wega  kĩa bataraitha iria ĩkũhũthĩrwo  ĩbatie kuumana na maumĩrĩra na ũrĩa tĩrĩ ũthuthurĩtwo.

sentences.source: Cabbage is widely grown across the world for its nutritional value.
sentences.translation: Thĩinĩ wa thĩ yothe nĩ kũrehagwo ng'ombe nyingĩ nĩ ũndũ wa irio iria irĩ nacio.
sentences.reference: Kabici ĩkũragio kũndũ kũingĩ  mũno thĩ nĩũndũ wa bata mwĩrĩ-inĩ.

sentences.source: Build relationships with local markets and restaurants for regular sales.
sentences.translation: Hũũra ũrata na ithandũkũ cia kũrĩa na iresitoranĩ nĩguo ũhote kũgũra.
sentences.reference: Tũma ngwatanĩro na thoko cia gũkũ na mĩkawa  nĩgetha  na wendagie hĩndĩ o hĩndĩ.

sentences.source: Frost during flowering can destroy wheat heads.
sentences.translation: Mũiyũro wa ngano hĩndĩ ya kũruga no ũniine mĩmera ya ngano.
sentences.reference: Heho nyĩngĩ no ĩthũkie ngano rĩrĩa ĩraruta kĩro.

sentences.source: This includes temperature and rainfall requirements
sentences.translation: Maũndũ macio nĩ hamwe na mabataro ma ũrugarĩ na mbura
sentences.reference: Ũndũ ũyũ nĩ hamwe na mabataro ma ũrugarĩ na mbura.

sentences.source: Loamy soils rich in organic matter are ideal for wheat farming.
sentences.translation: Thĩ ĩrĩa ĩkoragwo na ithaka nyingĩ nĩ njega mũno harĩ kũrĩma ngano.
sentences.reference: Tĩri wa kĩhukuhuku mũnoru nĩ mwega wa kũhanda ngano.

sentences.source: Pyrethrum plants should be cut back once a year.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ya pyrethrum yagĩrĩirũo kũgerio o mwaka.
sentences.reference: Mahũa ma mbeniko mabatie gũcehwo  rita rĩmwe o mwaka.

sentences.source: Altitude affects the length of the wheat growing season.
sentences.translation: Ũgima wa igũrũ nĩ ũhutagia ũraihu wa hĩndĩ ya kũmenyeria ngano.
sentences.reference: Ũraihu wa igũrũ na thĩ nĩ  ũhutagia kahinda ga kĩmera gĩa gũkũria ngano.

sentences.source: heavy frost, which can occur at high altitudes, causes reduction in yield
sentences.translation: Mũiyũro mũritũ, ũrĩa ũngĩoneka irĩ igũrũ mũno, nĩ ũrehaga mbeca cia gũciara
sentences.reference: Heho nyĩngĩ mũno  irĩmainĩ no inyihie maciaro.

sentences.source: in order to initiate flowering.
sentences.translation: nĩguo wambĩrĩrie kũruga.
sentences.reference: nĩgetha mahote kũruta kĩro.

sentences.source: For better drying farmers are advised to use a solar dryer.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo arĩmi mahote kũũmia wega, nĩ magĩrĩire kũhũthĩra indo cia kũũmia iria ciumanaga na ũtheri wa riũa.
sentences.reference: Nĩgeetha kũmithia wega arĩmĩ mataragwo mahũthire hinya wa thitima ya riũa.

sentences.source: It grows to a height of approximately one meter.
sentences.translation: Rĩkũraga na ũraihu wa mita ĩmwe.
sentences.reference: Ĩkũraga ta   hakuhĩ ũraihu  wa mita ĩmwe.

sentences.source: Fertilizers are usually applied in two doses: at planting and during growth.
sentences.translation: Kaingĩ marĩĩu maratumagwo na mĩthemba ĩĩrĩ: hĩndĩ ya kũhanda na hĩndĩ ya gũkũra.
sentences.reference: Bataraitha kaingĩ ĩkĩragwo maita merĩ, hĩndĩ ya kũhanda na hĩndĩ ya  mĩmera ĩgĩkũra.

sentences.source: Wheat grows best in well-drained, fertile soils.
sentences.translation: Ng'ombe ikũraga wega mũno thĩinĩ wa mĩgũnda mĩega na ĩtarĩ na maaĩ maingĩ.
sentences.reference: Ngano ĩkũraga wega tĩri-inĩ mũnoru na  ũikũrũkagia maĩ wega.

sentences.source: Early planting allows wheat to establish roots before cold weather
sentences.translation: Kũhaanda ngano tene nĩ gũtũmaga ĩrute mĩri mbere ya kũgĩa na heho
sentences.reference: Kũhanda tene nĩ gũteithagia mĩri ya ngano  kũambĩka  gũtanagĩa heho.

sentences.source: Sun drying is the most common method.
sentences.translation: Njĩra ĩrĩa ĩhũthĩrĩtwo mũno nĩ kũhĩa na riũa.
sentences.reference: Kũmithia na riũa nĩyo  njĩra ĩrĩa ĩhũthĩkaga mũno.

sentences.source: Wheat yields may decline at very high altitudes due to cold.
sentences.translation: Mĩgũnda ya ngano no yũre kũndũ kũraihu mũno nĩ ũndũ wa heho.
sentences.reference: Maciaro ma ngano no manyihe kũndũ kwĩ  ũraihu wa igũrũ nĩũndũ wa heho.

sentences.reference: Nĩ kũrĩ  mĩthemba ngũrani ya ngano hamwe na ĩrĩa  nyũmū na njororo.

sentences.source: Flowers should be harvested at the correct bud stage
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩyo yagĩrĩirũo kũgetwo hĩndĩ ĩrĩa yagĩrĩire
sentences.reference: Mahũa mabatiĩ gũtuo marĩkia gūthethuka wega.

sentences.source: Control pests to protect wheat from damage.
sentences.translation: Nĩguo ũgirĩrĩrie ng'ombe cia ng'ombe itigathũkio.
sentences.reference: Gitĩra ngano ndĩgathūke nĩ kugirĩrĩria tūtambĩ.

sentences.source: Flowers should not be picked under rainy conditions.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ndĩagĩrĩirũo kũgerio hĩndĩ ya mbura.
sentences.reference: Mahũa matibatie gũtuo  mbura ĩkiura.

sentences.source: Overripe wheat can shatter, causing grain loss during harvest.
sentences.translation: Ng'ombe iria ciakũra mũno no ihũke, na ũndũ ũcio ũgatuma mbeũ cianangwo hĩndĩ ya magetha.
sentences.reference: Ngano yakūra  mūno  no  ĩhehenjeke na ĩnyihie  magetha.

sentences.source: Plant the seeds at a depth of 2 to 3 centimeters.
sentences.translation: Ciarage mbeũ icio na ũritũ wa sentimita 2 nginya 3.
sentences.reference: Handa mbegũ ũrikũ wa [cs] centimetre [cs]  igĩrĩ nginya ithatũ.

sentences.source: Wheat can be grown in lowland and highland regions.

sentences.source: Timing is crucial to prevent losses during wheat harvest.
sentences.translation: Nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩka ũguo, nĩ harĩ bata mũno kũhingia ihinda rĩrĩa rĩagĩrĩire rĩa kũgetha ngano.

sentences.source: Consistent moisture levels help improve wheat yields.

sentences.source: Fumigation is used to protect stored wheat from insect infestations.
sentences.translation: Kũhumbĩra ngano nĩ kũhũthagĩrũo kũgitĩra ngano kuuma kũrĩ mĩrimũ.

sentences.source: It is a low-calorie vegetable with high fiber content.

sentences.source: Herbicides help control weeds that compete with wheat for nutrients.

sentences.translation: Ũndũ ũcio nĩ ũtũmaga mĩmera ya ngano ĩgĩe na maĩ maingĩ na ĩgĩe na mĩmera mĩega.

sentences.translation: Mĩmera ya ngano ĩgathondekwo, nayo ngano ĩgaatwarwo na njĩra ya gũthondekwo.

sentences.source: If you’re growing your own fodder you’ll need about 1 acre per year to feed one cow, one heifer and a calf.
sentences.translation: Ũngĩkũria irio ciaku we mwene no ũbatare hekarĩ ĩmwe o mwaka nĩguo ũhe ng'ombe ĩmwe, njaũ ĩmwe na ndũrũme ĩmwe irio.

sentences.source: This way, you’ll have enough good fodder for your cows even when it gets dry and milk prices go up.
sentences.translation: Na njĩra ĩyo, nĩ ũrĩgĩaga na irio njega cia kũhe ng'ombe ciaku o na rĩrĩa ikorũo irĩ njega na thogora wa iria ũgũkĩra.

sentences.source: The Coast and a few parts of the Highlands East of the Rift Valley received near to below average rainfall.
sentences.translation: Ihinda-inĩ rĩu, gĩcigo kĩa Rift Valley na gĩcigo kĩmwe kĩa Highlands mwena wa irathĩro wa Rift Valley nĩ kĩarĩ na mbura nene mũno.

sentences.source: Packaging protects the eggs from bacteria, natural predator, loss of moisture, temperatures that cause deterioration and crushing.
sentences.translation: Kũhumbĩra maya nĩ kũgitagĩra kuuma kũrĩ thigara, nyamũ iria ciũragwo na njĩra ya ndũire, gũthira kwa maĩ, mĩrimo ĩrĩa ĩrehaga gũthira na gũthira.

sentences.source: Bio-slurry/digestate when used as a fertilizer enhances physical, chemical, and biological attributes of the soil and increases crop productivity when applied to the land
sentences.translation: Kĩmera kĩa bio-slurry/digestate rĩrĩa kĩhũthĩrĩtwo ta kĩronda nĩ kĩongerera mĩtugo ya kĩĩmwĩrĩ, ya kemia, na ya biologic, na kĩongerera ũthii wa na mbere wa mĩmera rĩrĩa kĩhũthĩrĩtwo bũrũri-inĩ

sentences.source: Young trees need no pruning during the first 2 - 3 years.
sentences.translation: Mĩmera ĩrĩa mĩnini ndĩbataraga gũtherio mĩaka ĩĩrĩ kana ĩtatũ ya mbere.

sentences.source: Biogas improves health of rural low-income households by providing a cleaner cooking fuel and a waste handling solution thus avoiding health problems
sentences.translation: BIOGAS nĩ ĩteithagia mĩciĩ mĩhũmũ ya mĩgũnda kũgĩa na ũgima wa mwĩrĩ na njĩra ya kũhe andũ maguta ma kũruga marĩ na ũtheru na njĩra ya kũmenyeria mũtaratara wa kũmenyeria andũ na njĩra ĩyo ĩgĩthema mathĩna ma ũgima wa mwĩrĩ

sentences.source: Good housing should protect the birds from extreme weather and predators.
sentences.translation: Mũciĩ mwega nĩ wagĩrĩirũo kũgitĩra nyoni kuuma kũrĩ mĩiyũro mĩũru na nyamũ-ya-thĩ.

sentences.source: Plant young cocoa seedlings from your own nursery, or buy from a research centre.

sentences.source: Plant cocoa trees at the start of the rainy season.

sentences.source: Groundnuts are mature when 70-80% of the inside of the pods shells have dark markings and the kernels are plump, with colour characteristic of that variety.
